product.description: ProRad radiators come with three designs. Designs include type 11 (K1), Type 21 (P+) and Type 22 (K2). Slimline single panel designs (Type 11) have slighter footprints and are great for small spaces. product.name: Nuie Pearlstone White Offset Quadrant Right Hand Shower Tray
product.description: The Nuie Pearlstone White Offset Quadrant Right Hand Shower Tray maximises space in bathroom corners with its sleek, rounded edges that blend seamlessly with curved bathroom fixtures like W.C. units and bathtubs. Its low-profile design at just 40-45mm high adds a modern touch, while the glossy white finish complements a variety of bathroom styles. The 90mm shower waste is positioned in the right-hand corner, ensuring ample standing space for comfortable showering.Constructed from lightweight yet durable polyurethane resin and volcanic ash using the patented Pearlstone Matrix, this shower tray is easy to install and built to last. Its flat underside ensures a perfectly level installation on solid or timber floors, and its handy screw retention feature allows feet from the leg set to be securely attached. Backed by a lifetime guarantee, this is a trendy yet functional shower tray.Features & Benefits: Nuie Pearlstone White Offset Quadrant Right Hand Shower TrayA sleek, low-profile design at 40-45mm highVersatile gloss white finish to complement a wide range of bathtub and basin designsLightweight and easy to install and comes with a lifetime guaranteePlease note: Leg sets are sold separately.During installation, you must take extra care to avoid damaging the fittings. product.name: JTM Underground Drain Pipe Plug
product.description: The perfect product for when you need to block or seal off a drain pipe, this Underground Drain Pipe Plug can be purchased in different diameters. It works seamlessly when paired with the Underground Drainage system, intended to manage the drainage of high-temperature wastewater and foul discharge from above-ground drainage systems.The system can adapt to several installation requirements, and its extensive number of fittings, gullies and traps are made from lightweight PVC-U material, offering durability and ease of installation for above-ground and below-ground applications.Features & Benefits: JTM Underground Drain Pipe Plug Available in different diametersEasy to install and fitBlocks and seals drain pipesSuited to the Underground Drainage system for wastewater and foul discharge managementLightweight and durableDesigned without sharp edges, fittings provide a contemporary aesthetic alongside compact designs. Ideal for confined spaces, Push-Fit underground fittings simplify connections and comply with British Standard specifications. They feature double-ribbed seals and recessed sockets for robust and high-capacity pressure joints. User-friendly Push-Fit joints incorporate a sealing and snap cap system for added convenience.What's more, is the Socketed Underground Pipe's incorporate advanced blown-end technology and convenient, easy-to-fit rubber seals. The seal is securely positioned with a circular plastic insert to maintain integrity during transportation, as well as to permit seamless jointing.

product.name: JTM Underground Single Socket Long Radius Bend
product.description: The Underground Drainage system provides an efficient means of waste water drainage and foul discharge from above ground drainage systems. The range includes a variety of gullies and traps to suit most installations and integrate with above and below ground drainage systems. Manufactured in PVC-U to give a strong and durable product, lightweight and easy to work with. The system is suitable for high temperature waste discharge.Fittings have an aesthetic modern look, are compact in size yet remain within the British Standard specification. Push-Fit joint through an innovatively designed seal and snap cap system.Comprehensive range of fittings to suit most installations and which integrate with all Above and Below Ground Drainage Systems. The Socketed Underground Pipe incorporates the latest blown end technology. The easy fit rubber seal is held in place via a circular plastic insert allowing for retention of the seal in transit and a perfect connection for jointing.All Push-Fit underground fittings have a captive seal and snapcap which are designed to be user-friendly – no sharp edges, and with space restrictions in mind, allow for an easy fit connection. The seal is double ribbed, and the sockets incorporate a recessed area to provide space for the rubber seal to locate as the pipe is inserted, forming a high-capacity pressure joint.

product.name: Multipanel Linda Barker Onyx Marble Unlipped Shower Wall Panel
product.description: An excellent addition to your modern bathroom or wet room renovation, this Multipanel Linda Barker Graphite Elements Unlipped Shower Wall Panel is a fully waterproof solution with an authentic Onyx Marble design. Providing the charm and luxury of natural marble without compromising your budget, its light, delicate base tone and dark grey marble veining patterns make this panel a stylish choice for those seeking a chic, high-end finish.Designed by the renowned interior designer Linda Barker, this panel is part of her exclusive collection and draws inspiration from various natural elements such as wood, metal, and stone. This panel has an unlipped bare edge, which adds to its flexibility in fitting options, and it's a decorative alternative to wall tiles, which means no grout is required.Features & Benefits: Multipanel Linda Barker Onyx Marble Unlipped Shower Wall Panel11mm thick with an unlipped bare edge for versatile fitting optionsCan be installed over existing tiles100% recyclable, made from FSC-certified materials and has a 30-year warrantyPlease note: To maintain Multipanel's 30-year warranty, store panels flat, not vertically or on trestles, and condition at room temperature for 48 hours before installation.Use Multipanel High Grab Panel Adhesive/Sealant. The warranty covers product failure but is void if installation and care guidelines are not followed.For a 100% watertight seal, apply silicone at all edges, whether using profiles, shower enclosures, or the Hydrolock system. Use offcuts behind sinks for a coordinated look, sealing all exposed edges with profiles and silicone.To clean, use warm water and mild detergent. Avoid scouring products, as improper cleaning may invalidate the warranty.

product.name: JTM Stainless Steel Half Socket Machined
product.description: This 150lbs BSP half socket OD machined is manufactured from CF8M (316) stainless steel material and conforms to ISO 4144 standards. product.name: Geberit Mapress Copper Slip Coupling
product.description: The Geberit 'Mapress' system of fittings is a versatile, reliable, and time-saving solution for all sorts of plumbing applications. Combining easy installation, secure seals, and impressive longevity, the Mapress system is a compelling alternative to arduous hot works and traditional soldering.These copper slip couplings are part of the core system and are case-in-point for the time-saving technology on show with the Mapress line. The pressing procedure for these couplings is around twice as fast as soldering, with no open flames required, using cold deformation of both the fitting and the pipe itself. Each slip coupling has clear pressing indicators for fuss-free installation with your tools, with a huge variety of fittings available too. Fast connection, fast installation, and fast identification of leaks during pressure testing, and the Mapress system stands out for your next plumbing project, no matter the application.Features & Benefits: Geberit Mapress Copper Slip CouplingFast, flame-free installation up to twice as fast as traditional soldering techniquesHuge variety of fittings availableRange covers water, heating, cooling, and compressed air applicationsPressing indicators make installation easy and fuss-free

product.name: Prorad Double Convector Radiator Type 22 K2 500mm High
product.description: These ProRad radiators feature a decent range of designs: Type 11 (K1), Type 21 (P+) and Type 22 (K2). Slimline single panel designs (Type 11) work great in tight spaces and have smaller footprints. Larger units are bigger in size and have two panels and fins that offer higher heat outputs (BTU).Type 22 radiators include two convectors (rows of fins). By doubling the number of fins, the surface area of the radiator is increased and allows more heat to be produced. This increases the projection of the radiator. Type 22 radiators use both front and back panels to help retain the heat and allow for an improved distribution throughout the room.Features & Benefits: Prorad Double Convector Radiator Type 22 K2 500mm HighTwo convectors (rows of fins)Increased surface area lets more heat be producedProjection of the radiator also increasedFront and back panels to help retain the heatImproved distribution throughout the room

product.name: Templers Telux Flux
product.description: This Templers Telux flux is a general-purpose soldering flux used for capillary joints on copper pipework, brass and mild steel and other metals. It is supplied in 50gram and 450gram containers. Telux is UK WRAS listed for use with both hot and cold water including potable water. It is also suitable for use with gas pipework.For normal usage, remove any scale and oxide with emery cloth or wire wool. Wipe joint areas clean. Smear a thin film of this Telux to both surfaces and assemble. Apply heat with a soldering iron or blowtorch adding solder as required. Allow to cool and set, then wipe clean whilst still warm.Features & Benefits: Templers Telux FluxUsed for capillary joints on a variety of metalsSupplied in a range of sized containersFor use with both hot and cold water and gas pipeworkStandards & CertificationUK WRAS listedPlease note: Handling instructions: In normal use, it is advised that a suitable barrier cream be used to protect sensitive skin. Avoid inhaling fumes where possible but our tests have shown the fumes to be relatively harmless. Do not ingest this flux and avoid skin and eye contact.

product.name: Nabic 1 1/4 inch 500 High Lift Safety Valve
product.description: This NABIC 500 high lift safety valve has been designed primarily for use on unvented hot water heating systems where a high capacity, emergency steam relief capability is required. All wetted parts are manufactured from dezincification resistance materials. Designed and tested to BS EN ISO 4126-1 and WRAS approved (1 bar and above), this safety valve is available in a wide range of sizes and has a resilient PTFE seating design with a high degree of seat tightness. Ensuring easy inspection and cleaning, it has diaphragm protected parts and a locked and sealed pressure seating. product.name: Armacell Armaflex 32mm Slit Pipe Insulation 2m Lengths
product.description: These 2m lengths of slit Armaflex pipe insulation (also known as pipe lagging) is an exceptionally reliable and ever-popular Type O insulation, combining flexibility, reliability, and efficiency to produce a compelling and cost-effective insulation solution. In addition, unlike other insulation types, these Armaflex tubes retain their thermal properties over time, creating an essential moisture barrier to protect against pipe and part corrosion.The closed-cell structure of this insulation means that even when cut, this insulation retains its vapour-resistant qualities and won't release unwanted dust and fibres if you need to cut and trim on-site. In addition, with the flexibility of these tubes, it's easy to protect vulnerable components, creating truly and fully sealed systems for short-term as well as long-term savings. With a wide range of diameters available, this reliable Type O insulation remains popular for a good reason.Features & Benefits: Armacell Armaflex 32mm Slit Pipe Insulation 2m Lengths Retains thermal efficiency and energy efficiency over timeDust-free for easy installationAllows for fully sealed systems for short and long-term savings

product.name: Glow-Worm Energy7 System Boiler

It has been designed, manufactured and assembled in the UK by John Guest Speedfit. This connector uses a grip and seal, collet arrangement. Simply push the fitting fully onto the pipe and screw the nut onto the thread of the appliance. If the need arises to demount the connection, push the collet towards the body of the fitting and pull the pipe to release. This flexi hose fitting ensures an easier working environment in confined spaces and removes the need for hot works on site. product.name: Dekstrip Pipe and Chimney Flashing Grey TPE
product.description: This Dekstrip Pipe and Chimney Flashing Grey TPE is an incredibly versatile, expandable, lead-free flashing solution for pipes through metal roofs. It offers varying widths and roll lengths to suit multiple applications and utilises a specially formulated rubber polymer. The unique, patented internal aluminium strip allows the forming of almost any shape to seal and weatherproof.Used for expansion joints in walls and gutters, Dekstrip is ideal for large round or square penetrations, valleys, chimneys, bull nose roofs and skylights. What’s more, you can paint the surface, making it a versatile, elegant roof flashing product for almost any application. Use Dekstrip with butyl mastic sealant and self-drilling screws to seal pipes, ducts, skylights, chimneys, and different roofing profiles. product.name: Alumasc Heritage Aluminium Circular Downpipe
product.description:
This round downpipe is manufactured from aluminium, and is part of a wide range of aluminium guttering products from Alumasc.
Connections between pipes and fittings are made with loose cast sockets, available with ears for fixing back to the wall. Pipes can also be fixed with a choice of base clips to give alternative projections.
Applications

Ideal for traditionally designed buildings
Heritage downpipes are extruded sections with cast sockets
Compatible with all Alumasc aluminium gutter systems
Factory finished, in a choice of 1, 2 and 3 metre pipe lengths

Colours & Finishes

BBA approved polyester powder coatings
In-house powder coating facility
16 standard factory applied colours
BS or RAL colours available to special order
Can be supplied to resemble cast iron surface texture (black) to special order
Also available in plain mill finish for on-site painting

Performance

UK manufactured, extruded aluminium
Choice of circular, square and rectangular pipes
Lightweight, durable and non-corrodible
Easy to handle and fix
Life expectancy of aluminium: 40 years (rural/suburban areas); up to 25 years (industrial/marine areas)
Aluminium is 100% recyclable

Installation & Fixing

Pipe jointing by separate sockets gives maximum flexibility for installation
Simple fixing to wall by eared sockets or by a choice of pipe clips
Minimal maintenance requirements
product.variant_name: Aluminium Guttering Round Downpipe 63mm x 3m - Black

product.name: Alumasc Flushjoint Circular Downpipe Diverter
product.description:
Crafted in easy-to-handle, 100% recyclable extruded aluminium, this rainwater diverter is designed to fit neatly with the Alumasc Flushjoint circular downpipe system.
Create a truly customised system with this handy extra, finished in a range of powder-coated, BBA-approved colours - or available in a plain mill finish for on-site painting.
Whether you're installing on a refurbishment project or a brand new building development, the hidden spigot joints of the Flushjoint system will deliver a modern, streamlined aesthetic.
Alumasc Flushjoint Downpipes

Concealed spigots for smooth appearance – fits in with appearance of Alumasc Aqualine as a contemporary range
Compatible with Heritage, Aqualine and GX gutters
Not designed for use in underground drainage
Circular, square or rectangular pipes
Up to 40 years life expectancy
UK manufactured

product.name: Clivet Edge EVO 2.0-EXC Monobloc 1Phase Heat Pump
product.description: The Clivet Edge EVO 2.0-EXC 1-Phase Monobloc Heat Pump is a compact, all-in-one air-to-water system ideal for small homes seeking efficient heating, cooling and domestic hot water. With a single-phase operation, it suits typical residential electrical supplies while offering strong performance in demanding conditions. Despite its small footprint, it operates reliably down to -25 °C and can deliver hot water up to 65 °C.As a monobloc unit, all components are housed outdoors, simplifying installation and removing the need for indoor refrigeration equipment. The system also supports smart control through the MSmartLife App or Modbus integration, enabling remote monitoring and flexible management. Its efficient inverter technology helps reduce running costs while maintaining stable temperatures throughout the home.Features & Benefits: Clivet Edge EVO 2.0-EXC Monobloc 1Phase Heat PumpSingle-phase monobloc for compact installationsOperates to -25 °C and supplies up to 65 °C waterSmart control via MSmartLife App or Modbus

It has BSP parallel female ends and is available in a huge range of sizes from 1/4 inch to 4 inch, making it an endlessly versatile solution. The spring check valve is designed to strict British standards, highly resistant to corrosion and suitable for use in a wide number of plumbing applications. product.name: DeWalt Laser Black Safety Hiker
product.description: Perfect if you’re working within the construction or engineering industry, these DeWalt Laser Black Safety Hikers are safety boots based on the robust and sturdy hiking boot design, providing you with high levels of protection, comfort and durability.With a stylish, hardwearing black full-grain leather upper, these Laser Black Safety Hikers feature a padded tongue and collar for maximum comfort and support. The 200-joule steel toe cap will also protect your feet from falling heavy loads.Features & Benefits: DeWalt Laser Black Safety HikerSafety boot based on the robust and sturdy hiking boot designS1P safety ratingIdeal if you’re working within the construction or engineering industryPadded tongue and collar for maximum comfort200-joule steel toe cap and steel midsoleHeel support and dual-density outsole, made from strong and flexible TPUAnti-static energy absorption technologyAvailable in multiple sizesThese boots’ heel support and dual-density outsole is made from Thermoplastic Polyurethane (TPU), a strong, abrasion-resistant and flexible material. For additional protection underfoot, the steel midsole will also protect your feet from sharp objects.The anti-static energy absorption technology within these boots will conduct static electricity, keeping you safe from the risk of static sparks, which can be incredibly dangerous if working around flammable liquids and gasses.Standards & CertificationEuropean Standard: EN 20345: 2011 S1PSlip Resistance: SRCPlease note: This footwear has been tested on clay tiles with a sodium lauryl sulphate solution and meets a minimum Coefficient of Friction (CoF) of 0.32 tested flat and a CoF of 0.28 when tested at the heel.This footwear is also tested on stainless steel with a glycerol solution and meets a CoF of 0.18 when tested flat and 0.13 at the heel.

The 200-joule steel toe cap will also protect your feet from falling heavy loads.Features & Benefits: DeWalt Laser Black Safety HikerSafety boot based on the robust and sturdy hiking boot designS1P safety ratingIdeal if you’re working within the construction or engineering industryPadded tongue and collar for maximum comfort200-joule steel toe cap and steel midsoleHeel support and dual-density outsole, made from strong and flexible TPUAnti-static energy absorption technologyAvailable in multiple sizesThese boots’ heel support and dual-density outsole is made from Thermoplastic Polyurethane (TPU), a strong, abrasion-resistant and flexible material. For additional protection underfoot, the steel midsole will also protect your feet from sharp objects.The anti-static energy absorption technology within these boots will conduct static electricity, keeping you safe from the risk of static sparks, which can be incredibly dangerous if working around flammable liquids and gasses.Standards & CertificationEuropean Standard: EN 20345: 2011 S1PSlip Resistance: SRCPlease note: This footwear has been tested on clay tiles with a sodium lauryl sulphate solution and meets a minimum Coefficient of Friction (CoF) of 0.32 tested flat and a CoF of 0.28 when tested at the heel.This footwear is also tested on stainless steel with a glycerol solution and meets a CoF of 0.18 when tested flat and 0.13 at the heel.

product.name: Alumasc Heritage Aluminium Ornamental Rainwater Head
product.description:
A range of traditionally designed, socketed aluminium downpipes. Connections between pipes and fittings are made with loose cast sockets, available with ears for fixing back to the wall. Pipes can also be fixed with a choice of base clips to give alternative projections.Applications

Ideal for traditionally designed buildings
Heritage downpipes are extruded sections with cast sockets
Compatible with all Alumasc aluminium gutter systems
Factory finished, in a choice of 1, 2 and 3 metre pipe lengths

Colours & Finishes

BBA approved polyester powder coatings
In-house powder coating facility
16 standard factory applied colours
BS or RAL colours available to special order
Can be supplied to resemble cast iron surface texture (black) to special order
Also available in plain mill finish for on-site painting

Performance

UK manufactured, extruded aluminium
Choice of circular, square and rectangular pipes
Lightweight, durable and non-corrodible
Easy to handle and fix
Life expectancy of aluminium: 40 years (rural/suburban areas); up to 25 years (industrial/marine areas)
Aluminium is 100% recyclable

Installation & Fixing

Pipe jointing by separate sockets gives maximum flexibility for installation
Simple fixing to wall by eared sockets or by a choice of pipe clips
Minimal maintenance requirements
product.variant_name: Aluminium Guttering Round Downpipe Ornamental Hopper Head 63mm - Black

product.name: Baxi Duo-Tec Compact Combi Boiler
product.description: The Baxi Duo-Tec Compact Combi Boiler is designed for small to medium-sized homes, its compact dimensions allow for installation in standard 290mm deep kitchen cupboards, making it ideal for properties with up to 8 radiators. product.name: Multipanel Contemporary Senora Stone Unlipped Shower Wall Panel
product.description: A stunning, fully waterproof addition to your bathroom décor, the Multipanel Contemporary Senora Stone Unlipped Shower Wall Panel is a part of the Contemporary collection, providing the charm of natural stone without the price tag. Senora Stone comes with a soft white base colour, interspersed with tiny pieces of grey terrazzo, giving it a versatile look particularly suited to neutral and pastel tones. It will also harmonise beautifully with natural wood and stone bathroom décor.The unlipped bare edge provides flexibility in fitting options, and it is a decorative alternative to wall tiles that won't require grout. The panels are 11mm thick, lightweight and easy to handle, making them quick and hassle-free to install. They can even be installed over old tiles, saving you time and money.Features & Benefits: Multipanel Contemporary Senora Stone Unlipped Shower Wall PanelHas a soft white base colour, interspersed with tiny pieces of grey terrazzoQuick and simple to install and can be cut to size100% recyclable, made from FSC-certified materials and has a 30-year warrantyPlease note: To maintain Multipanel's 30-year warranty, store panels flat, not vertically or on trestles, and condition at room temperature for 48 hours before installation.Use Multipanel High Grab Panel Adhesive/Sealant. The warranty covers product failure but is void if installation and care guidelines are not followed.For a 100% watertight seal, apply silicone at all edges, whether using profiles, shower enclosures, or the Hydrolock system. Use offcuts behind sinks for a coordinated look, sealing all exposed edges with profiles and silicone.To clean, use warm water and non-abrasive mild detergent. Avoid scouring products, as improper cleaning may invalidate the warranty.

product.name: Microbubble Stainless Steel Air Separator
product.description: This Air Separator has been designed to eliminate problems arising through the air in a water system. Suitable for heating and chilled water systems, this Air Separator includes DN50 flanged connections. With reduced commissioning time after the initial fill, this air separator results in longer system life. Made from stainless steel construction with high corrosion resistance, this Air Separator is lightweight, reducing the need for extra support. With a large collector for large intervals between flushes, this Air Separator can be flushed while in operation. product.name: Altecnic Reflex Robokit Extra Pressure Vessel & Kit
product.description: Sealed central heating systems are highly effective and simple to install, and Robokit Extra is one of the best available on the UK market. These systems have to include an expansion vessel and certain ancillary components to accommodate water expansion. And the Robokit Extra kit consists of everything you need to get going, including an expansion vessel with a sealed system kit which contains an expansion vessel, a wall mounting bracket, a quattro 4-way connector, a safety relief valve complete with pressure gauge and a filling loop.Because it’s energy efficient and virtually maintenance-free, this kit will save you money on your energy bills for years to come. It will also improve the comfort of your home by significantly reducing noise thanks to higher system pressure. Built to the strictest British standards, it’s available in sizes from 8l to 80l, making it a convenient option for a wide variety of settings. Not designed for use in underground drainage
Circular, square or rectangular pipes
Up to 40 years life expectancy
UK manufactured

product.name: TracPipe CSST Gas Coils - 30m to 90m
product.description: These TracPipe OmegaFlex Semi-Rigid Corrugated Stainless Steel Tubing (CSST) Gas Pipe Coils are a popular and flexible alternative to traditional fixed copper piping, providing a high degree of versatility and usability without sacrificing quality. These pipes utilise a clever corrugated steel design that bends and flexes easily without deforming, sheathed with several other materials to produce a flexible, reliable, and versatile conduit for natural gas systems.TracPipe sections typically install up to three times faster than traditional steel or copper piping, a compelling argument for installers, and all without the need for soldering, welding, or specialist tools; simply bend the sections by hand. Suitable for external and internal use, these CSST sections can be used underground and overground without the need for additional mechanical or corrosion protection, making for a rugged and reliable system.Features & Benefits: TracPipe CSST Gas Coils - 30m to 90mFast and fuss-free installation, up to three times faster than traditional pipingNo soldering, welding, or specialist tools requiredRugged, reliable performance both internally and externallyBSI Kitemarked and class-leading B-S1 Euroclass fire ratingsAvailable in pre-packed kits and bulk coilsIn terms of safety and quality, TracPipe continues to tick boxes, holding BSI Kitemarks as well as class-leading B-S1 EUROCLASS Reaction to Fire ratings. Available in a range of lengths and standard diameter nominals, it's clear to see why the TracPipe system is such a firm favourite amongst installers.

product.name: Glow-Worm Compact Combi Boiler with Vertical Flue, Adapter and System Filter
product.description: The Glow-Worm Compact Combi Boiler is a practical, energy-efficient heating solution with a modern design and simple controls for everyday ease of use. Built in the UK at Glow-worm's award-winning Belper factory, this compact combi boiler is designed to fit neatly into smaller spaces, with a 25mm spacer frame that enables piping behind the boiler while still fitting in standard 300mm cupboards.Supplied complete with a vertical flue, vertical adaptor and power system filter, this high-efficiency boiler helps keep running costs down while delivering reliable heating and hot water. product.name: DEKTITE Black Ezi-Seal EPDM Pipe Flashing for Metal Roofs
product.description: Dektite Ezi-Seal is a super convenient, easy to use black EPDM (Ethylene Propylene Diene Terpolymer, a highly durable synthetic rubber roofing membrane) flashing solution for pipes on metal roofs. product.description: This high-performance mixing valve from JTM blends hot and cold water, providing constant safe shower and bath outlet temperatures while also preventing scalding. It's ideally suited for various applications in healthcare, residential and commercial settings. The mixing valve is approved by BuildCert (a product testing and certification programme for plumbing products) and meets relevant specifications. A range of traditionally designed, socketed aluminium downpipes. Connections between pipes and fittings are made with loose cast sockets, available with ears for fixing back to the wall. Pipes can also be fixed with a choice of base clips to give alternative projections.Applications

Ideal for traditionally designed buildings
Heritage downpipes are extruded sections with cast sockets
Compatible with all Alumasc aluminium gutter systems
Factory finished, in a choice of 1, 2 and 3 metre pipe lengths

Colours & Finishes

BBA approved polyester powder coatings
In-house powder coating facility
16 standard factory applied colours
BS or RAL colours available to special order
Can be supplied to resemble cast iron surface texture (black) to special order
Also available in plain mill finish for on-site painting

Performance

UK manufactured, extruded aluminium
Choice of circular, square and rectangular pipes
Lightweight, durable and non-corrodible
Easy to handle and fix
Life expectancy of aluminium: 40 years (rural/suburban areas); up to 25 years (industrial/marine areas)
Aluminium is 100% recyclable

Installation & Fixing

Pipe jointing by separate sockets gives maximum flexibility for installation
Simple fixing to wall by eared sockets or by a choice of pipe clips
Minimal maintenance requirements

product.name: Belimo 2 Port Valve & 230v Actuator with Powered Open & Close
product.description: This Belimo valve and actuator combo is a reliable and versatile product for automating hot and cold water systems. The valve operates via signals sent to the actuator mounted above, allowing a high degree of control. The actuator controls both the valve's opening and closing movement and comes in a range of standard imperial pipe diameters.With a nickel-plated hot-pressed brass valve housing, these valves can be relied on for long-lasting performance throughout the life of your system and can be retrofitted with other actuators in Belimo's extensive range. product.name: Alumasc Flushjoint Circular 92.5 Degree Two Part Offset
product.description:
Available in a range of sizes and polyester powder-coated factory finishes, this circular 92.5 degree two-part offset is compatible with the bestselling Alumasc Flushjoint downpipe range.
Choose your colour, or opt for a plain mill finish for on-site painting, and browse the many corresponding fittings to create a streamlined finish that's perfect for modern buildings and refurbishment projects.
Crafted in extruded aluminium to BS EN 12020:2001, BS EN 515:1993, BS EN 573:1995 and BS EN 755, every part of the Flushjoint system is built to offer a life expectancy of up to 25 years (or 40 depending on the surrounding environment) for total peace of mind.

Concealed spigots for smooth appearance – fits in with appearance of Alumasc Aqualine as a contemporary range

Not designed for use in underground drainage
Circular, square or rectangular pipes
Up to 40 years life expectancy
UK manufactured

product.name: John Guest Speedfit Flexi Hose Valve Metal Connections
product.description: This push-fit flexi hose is suitable for the connection of plastic and copper pipe to a male thread appliance, ideal for connecting taps. It has been designed, manufactured and assembled in the UK by John Guest Speedfit. To isolate your appliance, simply turn the screw in the valve a ¼ turn. To make a connection, simply push the fitting fully onto the pipe and screw the nut onto the thread of the appliance. If the need arises to demount the connection, push the collet towards the body of the fitting and pull the pipe to release. This flexi hose, with a service valve and metal connections, ensures an easier working environment in confined spaces and removes the need for hot works on site. Installation can be reduced by around 40% against traditional fixing methods. John Guest Speedfit limited offer a two-year guarantee against any defect in materials or manufacture. Maintaining control over the whole process from initial tool design and tool making through to final assembly and testing ensures that this flexi hose is produced to the highest quality. John Guest Speedfit believe that it is this commitment to quality that has led to it receiving awards from many of the world’s leading testing and approvals organisations. Please note: With all plastic pipes, the relevant manufacturer’s insert is required.This flexi hose is not suitable for central heating systems.

product.name: Multipanel Classic Stardust Unlipped Shower Wall Panel
product.description: The Multipanel Classic Stardust Unlipped Shower Wall Panel will take your bathroom or wet room's décor to new heights with this fully waterproof, decorative wall panel seamlessly blending style and functionality for an unparalleled shower experience. Use offcuts behind sinks for a coordinated look, sealing all exposed edges with profiles and silicone.To clean, use warm water and mild detergent. Heritage downpipes are extruded sections with cast sockets

Colours & Finishes

BBA approved polyester powder coatings
In-house powder coating facility
16 standard factory applied colours

Performance

UK manufactured, extruded aluminium
Choice of circular, square and rectangular pipes

Easy to handle and fix
Life expectancy of aluminium: 40 years (rural/suburban areas); up to 25 years (industrial/marine areas)

Pipe jointing by separate sockets gives maximum flexibility for installation

Minimal maintenance requirements

product.name: Tesla Titanium Immersion Heater with Thermostat
product.description: Ensure a dependable hot water supply with the Tesla Titanium Immersion Heater with Thermostat, a high-performance solution designed for domestic hot water cylinders. Supplied with a dual safety thermostat, fibre washer and manual-reset over-temperature cut-out, it provides effective temperature control and added protection against overheating. product.name: JTM Copper M-Profile Branch Reducing Tee
product.description: This high quality JTM M Profile copper tee is suitable for use in hot and cold drinking water and HVAC (heating, ventilation and air conditioning) applications. It’s highly resistant to oxidisation and corrosion, and you can install it quickly and without any hassle with an M Profile press machine. This fitting can be used with hard, half-hard and soft copper tube designed to EN 1057 standards, making it very versatile. What’s more, it’s available in a large number of sizes that range from 22mm x 22mm x 15mm all the way up to 76 x 76 x 67mm for larger commercial applications. Smaller sizes up to 54 mm have a specially designed O-ring with leak detection indicators. product.name: Ideal Heating HP290 DHW Pre-Plumbed 1 Zone Heat Pump Cylinder with Buffer Tank
product.description: The Ideal Heating HP290 DHW Pre-Plumbed 1 Zone Heat Pump Cylinder is a ready-to-install hot water solution designed specifically for homes running on air source heat pump technology. With its large storage capacity, it's a great fit for medium-sized households that need energy-efficient hot water throughout the day. The pre-plumbed layout gives both homeowners and installers a system that's tidy and efficient right from the start.What sets this model apart is its integrated 70-litre buffer tank, a valuable addition that helps stabilise heat pump performance. product.description: The Samsung EHS Mono R32 3-Phase Outdoor Heat Pump is a powerful and efficient air-to-water system designed for homes that need reliable, year-round heating and cooling. product.name: Self-Colour Black Malleable Mild Steel Pre-Cut Tube 1 inch (33.4mm OD)
product.description: This mild steel self-colour pre-cut tube with screwed both ends from JTM is ideal for DIY projects on both smaller and more advanced levels. It’s certified to BS1387 standard, making it suitable for use on hot and cold waterlines, firefighting lines, certain fuel lines and more. Because it’s self-colour, this durable tube is ideal for DIYers who would like to have the option to either weld the product or paint it in a particular colour to better fit their project requirements.  The wall thickness of these 1" malleable mild steel pipes is 3.2mm, and they have a 34mm outside diameter. They’re available in a wide range of lengths from 62mm to 3000mm and are extremely quick and easy to install, making them an extremely versatile and highly convenient solution. What’s more, JTM is happy to get longer lengths of tubing cut to any size upon request. Features & Benefits: Self-Colour Black Malleable Mild Steel Pre-Cut Tube 1 inch (33.4mm OD)High quality product  Designed to BS1387 standard  Can be welded or painted  3.2mm wall thickness for 1 inch  Available in 62mm-3000mm lengths or bespoke cuts  Quick and easy to installPlease note: All threads may not be identical. When requesting tubing cuts to a specific length, the result may be in or out by a couple of millimetres. Requested cut lengths of tubing cannot be returned for a refund unless previously approved due to this being a bespoke item made to the customer’s request. The actual outside diameter of the tube does measure differently to the size quoted due to the steel piping being a measure of the internal rather than the external diameter.

product.name: 2 Header Kit for Back to Back Installation
product.description: This Ideal Commercial Boilers header kit is designed for modular (cascade) boiler installations accommodating multiple PHEX and/or LLH boilers. The kit is available with an output range of 30-150kW (DN80-DN150) configured in a back-to-back arrangement. These kits offer users the flexibility to select the most optimal spatial layout to meet precise heat output requirements in commercial settings. Furthermore, they effectively reduce operational delays and interruptions while simultaneously enhancing efficiency over an extended period.The kit includes pre-insulated flow & return headers with mixing and gas header, all with fixing brackets. For easy connection, flexible stainless steel pipe and connections are supplied together with pressure relief valves, boiler shut off valves and a drain cock. ErP modulating shunt pumps are also included.Features & Benefits: 2 Header Kit for Back to Back InstallationPowerful kit for distributing output between multiple PHEX and/or LLH boilersBack-to-back arrangementSuitable for commercial applications30-150kW outputDN80-DN150 outlet size optionsComes complete with everything you need for a hassle-free installationFlexible stainless steel pipe for durability

product.name: Vaillant EcoFit Pure System Natural Gas Boiler
product.description: These EcoFit Pure System Boilers  are the most compact range developed by Vaillant to date, making them perfect for smaller homes. Lightweight for easy installation, they also include top or rear flue options. The Vaillant EcoFit Pure System Natural Gas Boiler is your go-to choice if you're seeking an efficient and space-saving heating solution for your home. Designed with flexibility in mind, this cupboard-size system boiler is perfect for homes with limited space. You can position it with ease, thanks to the rear flue option, granting you greater freedom in its placement. With multiple output options available, you can select the perfect fit for your heating needs.Features & Benefits: Vaillant EcoFit Pure System Natural Gas BoilerThis smart and efficient boiler features a powerful aluminium heat exchanger that ensures outstanding performance while keeping energy consumption to a minimum. The patented 4-sided cooling and water agitation system in the heat exchanger reduces stress on the unit, promoting longer life reliability and cutting down on maintenance costs. In addition, the EcoFit Pure System Boiler is designed to be eco-friendly and cost-effective, automatically reducing its output to just 20% of its maximum capacity when less heat is required.

product.name: Nuie Pearlstone 700mm White Rectangular Shower Tray
product.description: The Nuie Rectangular Shower Tray offers a sleek, modern design with a glossy white finish that complements contemporary bathroom suites. Its slimline profile of just 40-45mm ensures safe and easy access for all ages, making it a practical choice for family bathrooms. Available in various sizes, this 700mm wide shower tray fits seamlessly into any bathroom layout, while its lightweight construction makes installation a breeze.Crafted from durable polyurethane resin and volcanic ash, the patented Pearlstone Matrix guarantees long-lasting performance. The tray is acrylic-capped for added protection against everyday scuffs and scratches, and a 90mm shower waste is conveniently located in the right-hand corner for comfortable showering. Its flat underside ensures a perfectly level installation on solid or timber floors.Features & Benefits: Nuie Pearlstone 700mm White Rectangular Shower TrayYou can screw feet from the leg set (sold separately) directly into the baseThe flat underside will help you achieve a level installation onto solid and timber floorsLifetime guaranteePlease note: Leg sets are sold separately.During installation, you must take extra care to avoid damaging the fittings. product.name: Grundfos MAGNA1 25 180 A RatedEuP Ready Variable Speed Circulator 240V
product.description:
With the addition of this MAGNA1 variable speed circulator from Grundfos, you can deliver the required high energy efficiency, but with a reduced set of features. This pump can offer the perfect solution in a refurbishment situation where you need to either replace a Grundfos UPS product or one of the smaller models from the original Magna family. This pump is designed for circulating liquids in heating systems with variable flows where it is desirable to optimise the settings of the pump duty point, thus reducing energy costs. This MAGNA1 circulator comes complete with electronically controlled motors that are based on permanent magnet (PM) and stator technology. This circulator has been designed for circulating liquids in a wide range of light commercial and commercial applications including heating, air conditioning and cooling, domestic water, ground-source heat pump and solar heating systems. Features & Benefits: Grundfos MAGNA1 25 180 A RatedEuP Ready Variable Speed Circulator 240VLow energy consumptionComplies with EuP 2013 and 2015 requirementsSimple installationNine possible pump settingsLow noise levelMinimal maintenanceLong lifeConstant curve/constant speed dutyRange is available for a maximum system pressure of 16 bar (PN16)Proportional and constant pressure control Providing proportional and constant pressure control, this circulator does not require external motor protection and has a constant curve/speed duty. Insulating shells are supplied with single-head pumps for heating systems. This circulator has a wide temperature range where the liquid temperature and the ambient temperature are independent of each other. Product SpecificationMaterial

product.name: Clivet Edge F R290 1Phase Monobloc Heat Pump
product.description: The Clivet Edge F R290 1-Phase Monobloc Heat Pump is a compact, high-efficiency air-to-water system providing heating in winter and cooling in summer from a single unit. Using ultra-low-GWP R290 refrigerant, it delivers sustainable performance with zero CO2 emissions at the point of use, producing more heat with less energy consumed. Suitable for renovations and modern homes alike, it works efficiently even with radiator systems thanks to supply temperatures up to 75°C, and operates reliably down to -25°C. Its quiet design, from 40 dB(A), makes it ideal for residential settings.Featuring built-in Wi-Fi smart control, the unit integrates easily with solar thermodynamic systems and includes an energy meter for tracking energy produced and absorbed over time.Features & Benefits: Clivet Edge F R290 1Phase Monobloc Heat PumpHeating & cooling in one R290 high-efficiency monoblocWorks with radiators up to 75°C water temperatureUp to six units can be combined in a cascade arrangement

product.name: Prorad Double Convector Radiator Type 22 K2 600mm High
product.description: These ProRad radiators feature a decent range of designs: Type 11 (K1), Type 21 (P+) and Type 22 (K2). Slimline single panel designs (Type 11) work great in tight spaces and have smaller footprints. Larger units are bigger in size and have two panels and fins that offer higher heat outputs (BTU).Type 22 radiators include two convectors (rows of fins). By doubling the number of fins, the surface area of the radiator is increased and allows more heat to be produced. This increases the projection of the radiator. Type 22 radiators use both front and back panels to help retain the heat and allow for an improved distribution throughout the room.Features & Benefits: Prorad Double Convector Radiator Type 22 K2 600mm HighTwo convectors (rows of fins)Increased surface area lets more heat be producedProjection of the radiator also increasedFront and back panels to help retain the heatImproved distribution throughout the room

product.name: Armacell EVO Armaflex Self-Seal Pipe Insulation Full Boxes 2m Lengths - Thickness 9mm
product.description: This box of Armaflex pipe insulation (also known as pipe lagging) is an economical option for purchasing this ever-popular Type O insulation, combining flexibility, reliability, and efficiency to produce a compelling and cost-effective insulation solution. In addition, unlike other insulation types, these Armaflex tubes retain their thermal properties over time, creating an essential moisture barrier to protect against pipe and part corrosion.The closed-cell structure of this insulation means that even when cut, this insulation retains its vapour-resistant qualities and won't release unwanted dust and fibres if you need to cut and trim on-site. In addition, with the flexibility of these SelfSeal tubes, it's easy to protect vulnerable components, creating truly and fully sealed systems for short-term as well as long-term savings. product.name: Geberit Mapress 90 Degree Copper Street Elbow
product.description: These 90° street elbows are part of Gerberit's popular 'Mapress' system of fittings, a versatile solution for a wide variety of plumbing applications, including water, gas, compressed air, heating and cooling. product.name: Alumasc Heritage Aluminium Circular 112.5 Degree Offset
product.description:
A range of traditionally designed, socketed aluminium downpipes. Connections between pipes and fittings are made with loose cast sockets, available with ears for fixing back to the wall. Pipes can also be fixed with a choice of base clips to give alternative projections.Applications

Ideal for traditionally designed buildings
Heritage downpipes are extruded sections with cast sockets
Compatible with all Alumasc aluminium gutter systems
Factory finished, in a choice of 1, 2 and 3 metre pipe lengths

Colours & Finishes

BBA approved polyester powder coatings
In-house powder coating facility
16 standard factory applied colours
BS or RAL colours available to special order
Can be supplied to resemble cast iron surface texture (black) to special order
Also available in plain mill finish for on-site painting

Performance

UK manufactured, extruded aluminium
Choice of circular, square and rectangular pipes
Lightweight, durable and non-corrodible
Easy to handle and fix
Life expectancy of aluminium: 40 years (rural/suburban areas); up to 25 years (industrial/marine areas)
Aluminium is 100% recyclable

Installation & Fixing

Pipe jointing by separate sockets gives maximum flexibility for installation
Simple fixing to wall by eared sockets or by a choice of pipe clips
Minimal maintenance requirements

product.name: Pegler Yorkshire Xpress Copper S7 Press Female Adaptor
product.description: This Xpress copper press female adaptor has so many benefits and ensures major savings in installation costs and time compared with traditional jointing methods as it is part of a completely heat-free jointing system that requires no additional solders, adhesives, compounds, gas, hot works permits or costly insurance. With rapid, clean, heat-free jointing without complicated clamping techniques, long preparation procedures or waiting for adhesive to dry, this Xpress adaptor is safe without the need for naked flames. With a perfectly clean internal bore, less finishing or cleaning is required and there is no localised annealing from high temperature working. Without carbon deposits, internal solder runs or flux residue, this adaptor decreases the risk of corrosion while the system does not need to be ‘dry’ for effective jointing.Features & Benefits: Pegler Yorkshire Xpress Copper S7 Press Female AdaptorIdeal for diverse applicationsSaves installation costs and timeRapid, heat-free jointingPefectly clean internal boreSafety with no naked flamesWide range of approvalsAssured electrical continuitySelection of sizesReduced risk of corrosionXpress Copper fitting This Xpress fitting has a wide range of approvals including Kitemark, WRAS and DVGW and electrical continuity is assured when the XPress jointing process is complete. This Xpress adaptor is ideal for a diverse variety of applications such as domestic maintenance and refurbishment, new build and large-scale public sector projects.

Whether for domestic or commercial use, this valve is a dependable solution to keeping your system operating safely and efficiently. product.description: The Clivet Edge EVO 2.0-EXC 3-Phase Monobloc Heat Pump is a high-performance air-to-water system suited to larger homes or light commercial properties. product.name: John Guest Speedfit Polybutylene Layflat Pipe
product.description: Made in the UK by JG Speedfit, this Layflat Polybutylene Pipe has even greater flexibility, making it incredibly easy to handle and worry-free. This barrier pipe is ideal for long runs where a softer pipe material is an advantage, so cabling through joints becomes a simple task.When removed from the coil, this pipe keeps straight and ‘lays flat’ meaning there are no issues with retaining its memory and trying to coil back into place. It is made of five layers, the centre of which is a coloured oxygen barrier, which prevents air ingress into the system, reducing the effect of corrosion on metal components. Due to its low thermal conductivity when carrying hot water, it is cooler and therefore safer to touch. Features & Benefits: John Guest Speedfit Polybutylene Layflat PipeLays flat and stays flatEasy to handle and ideal for cabling through joists Suitable for central heating systems Polybutylene material for extra flexibility Manufactured and Kitemarked to British Standard BS7291: Parts 2 and Class S Lightweight and ultra flexible Lead-free and non-toxicThe strictest control is maintained because design and manufacture are carried out in modern purpose-built manufacturing centres in west London and Maidenhead in Berkshire. Controlling the whole process, from initial tool design and tool making to final assembly and testing, ensures that only products of the highest quality are produced. John Guest Speedfit believe that this commitment to quality has led to it receiving awards from many of the world’s leading testing and approvals organisations.

product.name: JTM Large Stainless Steel Parallel Spring Check Valve
product.description: This high-quality spring-loaded check valve by JTM utilises a spring to help close the check valve prior to fluid flow reversal. It helps prevent backflow and eliminates the hydraulic shock. Made from stainless steel, it features a metal seat. It has BSP parallel female ends and is available in a huge range of sizes from 1/4" to 4", making it an endlessly versatile solution. Sizes 1/4"-1" are 82 bar rated, 1 1/4"-1 1/2" 69 bar rated and 2"-4" 62 bar rated. The spring check valve is suitable for use in a wide number of plumbing applications and can operate in temperatures between -25°C and +180°C. Last but not least, it’s approved by ATEX (the European certification granted to equipment tested to be intrinsically safe), so you know it’s built to the highest industry standards and safe to use. product.name: Dektite Seldek Aluminium Base EPDM Pipe Flashing for Pitched Roofs
product.description: A durable flashing solution for pipes through slate and tile roofs, Dektite Seldek Aluminium won't corrode or stain your roof and gutters. The EPDM (Ethylene Propylene Diene Terpolymer) cone is a highly durable synthetic rubber roofing membrane that is trimmed to fit on-site and ingeniously locked to a high-grade and malleable 99.9% pure aluminium base. The pitched design of the flashing delivers a less-distorted cone when fit to a steeper pitch.Seldek Aluminium is a fast and economical way to flash a tile roof with a pitch between 0° and 45°. Ideal for use with standard pipes where constant heat temperatures go up to 115°C and intermittent ones go up to 150°C, Seldek Aluminium is available in multiple diameters. product.name: Imax Xtra 2 Low Loss Header
product.description: These Imax Xtra 2 magnetic low loss mixing headers by Ideal Commercial Boilers allows for flow separation within a hydronic system. product.name: McAlpine MacValve Self Closing Waste Valve
product.description: This MacValve self-closing waste valve can be fitted both horizontally and vertically. The MacValve membrane opens under water pressure to allow discharge to flow freely, then closes to form a tight seal that prevents foul odours or sewer gases from entering the building.  This MacValve can be fitted in many installations where a non-return is beneficial and can also be used to take the discharge from a pressure relief valve on an unvented domestic hot water storage system. When this MacValve is installed horizontally, the flow arrow must be in the uppermost position. This MacValve can be fitted in many installations where a non-return is beneficial and can also be used to take the discharge from a pressure relief valve on an unvented domestic hot water storage system. When this MacValve is installed horizontally, the flow arrow must be in the uppermost position. Features & Benefits: McAlpine MacValve Self Closing Waste ValveMembrane remains sealedFor installations where a non-return is beneficialFits horizontally or verticallyNo water seal to prevent dry out through evaporation or lack of useSize options available Please note: This MacValve self-closing waste valve is not recommended for use with shower trays unless there is access for maintenance.

product.name: MAGNA1 D 240 A RatedEuP Ready Variable Speed Twin Head Circulator 240V
product.description: This Grundfos MAGNA1 D50 series (240) 'A' Rated/EuP Ready variable speed twin head circulator with an easy selection of pump settings has no maintenance requirements and an extremely low life cycle cost. This MAGNA1 circulator pump is designed for circulating liquids in heating systems with variable flows and for domestic hot-water systems.Applications include main pump, mixing loops, heating systems, air-conditioning and heating. This pump is also suitable for systems with hot-water priority as an external signal can immediately force the pump to operate according to the maximum curve, for example in solar heating systems.Features & Benefits: MAGNA1 D 240 A RatedEuP Ready Variable Speed Twin Head Circulator 240VLow noise levelMaintenance-free and long lifeLow energy consumptionSimple installationSafe selectionLiquid temperature range from -10°C to 110°CWater pumped liquidThree proportional-pressure curves, three constant-pressure curves and three fixed-speed curves availableNine light fields for indication of pump settingsComplies with EuP requirementsThese MAGNA1 D50-40 to 50-80 circulators have 240mm port-to-port dimensions, D50-120 to D50-180 have 280mm port-to-port dimensions and all have 50mm flanged connections. Please note: Due to differences in port-to-port dimensions when replacing MAGNA or UPS/D models with an indicated MAGNA1, a space kit may be required. These are available as two kits; 40mm MAGNA3 models or 50mm MAGNA3 models. Each set includes a suitable spacer, a set of extended bolts, nuts and three gaskets.

product.name: Dektite Seldek Nu-Lead EPDM Pipe Flashing
product.description: You can ease your concerns about unprotected lead with Seldek Nu-Lead, the flashing solution for pipes through slate and tile roofs. product.name: Fernox HP-EG Heat Transfer Fluid
product.description:
Fernox HP-EG Heat Transfer Fluid is a concentrated, high-performance solution manufactured for Air and Ground Source Heat Pump systems, based on ethylene glycol. This advanced fluid ensures a prolonged system lifespan by providing superior corrosion and limescale protection. Notably, it offers frost protection ranging from -10°C (25% concentration) to an impressive -33°C (50% concentration), allowing users to adjust protection levels depending on specific requirements.
Apart from its frost-resistant attributes, Fernox HP-EG enhances energy efficiency with its lower viscosity compared to propylene glycol alternatives. This results in reduced energy consumption during fluid circulation, contributing to both cost savings and environmentally conscious operations.
Features & Benefits: Fernox HP-EG Heat Transfer FluidA concentrated, high-performance fluid for Air and Ground Source Heat Pumps based on ethylene glycolWill prolong your system's lifespan with superior corrosion and limescale protectionFrost protection from -10°C to -33°C, adjustable based on concentration (25% to 50%)Enhances energy efficiency with lower viscosity, reducing fluid circulation energy consumptionOutstanding pH buffering maintains optimal pH for mixed-metal systemsSeamless compatibility with all metals and materials commonly found in heat pump systems
The fluid's outstanding pH buffering capabilities maintain an optimal pH level for mixed-metal systems, preventing corrosion and ensuring system health. Fernox HP-EG is a cost-effective solution prioritising thermal efficiency, making it a wise choice for those seeking reliable performance within budget constraints. It seamlessly works with all metals and materials commonly found in heat pump systems.
Please note: Dilute before use using mains water. Deionised water (demineralised) or artificially softened water is also suitable if preferred. To ensure adequate corrosion protection, the minimum ‘in-use’ concentration is 25%.Frost protection levels can be checked using a Fernox Refractometer. Existing heating systems should be cleaned of sludge and limescale deposits with a suitable Fernox Cleaner before adding Fernox HP-EG.

product.name: Tracpipe CSST Installers Kit With Fittings & Tape
product.description: Offering a dynamic and adaptable alternative to conventional fixed copper piping, this TracPipe Corrugated Stainless Steel Tubing (CSST) Installers Kit has garnered significant popularity. This comprehensive kit caters to both interior and exterior applications, facilitating hassle-free male-to-male connection through its inclusive array of AutoFlare fittings and purpose-built sealing tape.Featuring an innovatively designed corrugated steel structure, the pipes effortlessly bend and flex without compromising their integrity. Enhanced with composite sheathing, they provide a dependable conduit for natural gas systems, ensuring remarkable flexibility and reliability. Notably, the TracPipe system boasts an installation speed of up to three times faster than traditional steel or copper piping, presenting a compelling advantage for installers. The absence of soldering, welding or specialised tools streamlines the installation process, allowing for effortless manual manipulation of the sections.Features & Benefits: Tracpipe CSST Installers Kit With Fittings & TapeIncludes TracPipe, two male AutoFlare adaptors and sealing tapeQuick and hassle-free installation, up to three times faster than traditional pipingNo soldering, welding, or specialist tools requiredRobust, reliable performance both internally and externallyAvailable in sizes DN12 to DN32 with a comprehensive range of fittingsSuperior gas flow rates, so smaller diameter pipes can be used – saves money without losing qualityDoes not require any hot works or special tools to attach the AutoFlare® fittingsNot annealed (softened) – stronger and more resistant to damageFor Natural Gas and Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) distribution2-hour (120 minutes) fire rating when installed in continuous lengths (no joints)With a strong emphasis on safety and quality, TracPipe proudly holds BSI Kitemarks and boasts leading B-S1 EUROCLASS Reaction to Fire ratings. Its availability in various lengths, standard diameter nominals and convenient pre-packed kits reflects its wide-ranging appeal and solidifies its status as a favoured choice. With the most up-to-date and comprehensive Design and Installation Specification, it fully reflects the requirements of both domestic and commercial/industrial installation standards for Natural Gas and Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG).Standards & CertificationBSI Kitemarked and class-leading B-S1 Euroclass fire ratingsBSI Kitemarked to both BS 7838 and BS EN 15266

product.name: Air & Dirt Separators
product.description: This combined air (deaerator) and dirt separator is demountable and features a high capacity auto air vent, fast bleed valve and drain valve. With greatly reduced commissioning times after the initial fill, this combined separator provides a longer system life due to the air and dirt elimination. As air collects in the air chamber before being automatically vented, floating dirt can be removed by opening the valve situated under the air vent. This same valve is used for releasing air when filling the system. The large collector ensures that flushing is only require now and then and can be flushed while fully operational without the need to shut down. Features & Benefits: Air & Dirt SeparatorsLow-pressure dropBi-directional flowMaximum temperature 110°CTested to 21 barAll stainless steel constructionMaximum flow rate up to 3m/secAir and dirt eliminationCorrosion and oxidation resistantSuperior themal propertiesRange of sizesWith an internal stainless steel concentrator to aid removal of air and dirt, the smooth surfaces, of this stainless steel separator, lead to lower friction. Additionally, the stainless steel material will not degrade in service thanks to its excellent resistance to corrosion and it is extensively more resilient to oxidation by water and biocides than carbon steel. Therefore, the stainless steel is not contributing to oxidation, sludge’s, etc. The thermal properties of stainless steel are far superior to iron or carbon steel.

product.name: Prorad Double Panel Single Convector Radiator Type 21 300mm High
product.description: ProRad radiators come with three designs. Designs include type 11 (K1), Type 21 (P+) and Type 22 (K2). product.name: Zilmet Robokit Intafil Pressure Sealed System Kit
product.description: This Robokit Intafill pressure vessel and Sealed System Kit from Zimlet is an excellent all-in-one system for retrofitting or part of a new build. product.description: This flange adaptor is part of the Pegler VSH power press range as a system designed for thick wall steel pipe. product.name: JTM BS4504 PN16 Steel Slip-on Flange
product.description: The JTM BS4504 PN16 slip-on flange provides a practical way to form a bolted flange connection in compatible pipework installations. Designed to slide over the end of a pipe before being permanently secured as part of the installation, it can be used to connect pipework to matching flanges, valves, pumps and other flanged equipment. Its circular design and pre-drilled bolt holes allow the flange to be aligned and fastened to a matching connection, with an appropriate gasket and fixing arrangement selected for the system.Manufactured from steel, this range follows the BS4504 PN16 dimensional pattern, helping installers identify the correct flange outside diameter, bolt-hole quantity and pitch circle diameter (PCD) for the connection. PN16 identifies the flange pressure class; suitability for a particular system should always be checked against the complete installation, including the mating flange, pipework, gasket, operating temperature and pressure.Features & Benefits: JTM BS4504 PN16 Steel Slip-on FlangePressure Class - PN16Dimensional Standard - BS4504Flange Type - Slip-onSurface Finish - Black primerThe flange is supplied with a black primer finish for temporary surface protection. Some chipping or flaking of this coating can occur in transit without affecting the flange itself; suitable corrosion protection should be applied as required once installed. Bolts are not included and must be purchased separately. Check the corresponding flange dimensions and choose compatible bolts and sealing components before installation.

product.name: JTM 50mm Dial Pipeline Pressure Gauge
product.description: This compact 50mm dry pressure gauge by JMT is ideal for the measurement of gases (except for oxygen and acetylene) up to 10 bar and fluid liquids up to 60 degrees which are not corrosive to copper or tin alloys or likely to solidify/crystallise in HVAC (heating, ventilation and air conditioning) and water system applications. Complete with a black enamelled steel case, push-fit plastic window and brass/bronze wetted parts, it can measure an impressive range of pressures with excellent accuracy of +/-2.5% FSD in ambient temperatures from -20 degrees to 60 degrees. product.name: Hudson Reed Urban 2-Door/Drawer Free Standing Satin White Vanity Unit & Basin 1
product.description: With a smooth and shiny mid-edge ceramic basin, the standing drawer and door units from Hudson Reed are versatile and stylish. The handle-less design is slick and particularly modern, and it makes for a completely smooth appearance with quiet soft-close drawers and doors.The door and drawer vanity units don't slack on storage space. product.name: John Guest Speedfit White Flexi Hose With Union Nut
product.description: This flexi hose is suitable for the connection of plastic or copper pipe to a male thread appliance such as a tap. It has been designed, manufactured and assembled in the UK by John Guest Speedfit. On one end, this hose features a push-fit connection for a supply pipe and on the other end, there is a plastic nut which can be hand tightened onto a tap or male thread. If the need arises to demount the connection, push the collet towards the body of the fitting and pull the pipe to release. This flexi hose fitting ensures an easier working environment in confined spaces and removes the need for hot works on site. Installation can be reduced by around 40% against traditional fixing methods. Features & Benefits: John Guest Speedfit White Flexi Hose With Union NutPVC hose materialPush-fit and demountable connection6 Bar at 65°CSold in singlesSpeedfit x union nutWhite finishFor the connection of plastic or copper pipe to a male thread applianceRange of sizes availableHand tightened onlyWRAS approved The strictest control is maintained by virtue of the fact that design and manufacture are carried out in modern purpose-built manufacturing centres in west London and at Maidenhead in Berkshire. Maintaining control over the whole process from initial tool design and tool making through to final assembly and testing ensures that this flexi hose is produced to the highest quality. John Guest Speedfit believe that it is this commitment to quality that has led to it receiving awards from many of the world’s leading testing and approvals organisations. Please note: With all plastic pipes, the relevant manufacturer’s insert is required.This flexi hose is not suitable for central heating systems.

product.name: Multipanel Contemporary Marfil Cream Tongue & Groove Hydrolock Shower Wall Panel
product.description: Multipanel's Contemporary Marfil Cream Tongue & Groove Hydrolock Shower Wall Panel is an affordable way to bring the luxurious feel of real stone to your bathroom. The panel's authentic stone-like finish, featuring a subtle marble veining pattern in cream and soft beige tones, creates an elegant and peaceful atmosphere that will transform your bathroom or wet room into a relaxing spa-like sanctuary.Forget about any concerns regarding water damage, as these panels are completely waterproof. The innovative Hydrolock tongue and groove edge not only makes joining the panels simple but also removes the need for any mid-joints. Achieve a smooth and almost uninterrupted surface with an impressive 6mm tolerance, ensuring an easy installation and a flawless finish every time.Features & Benefits: Multipanel Contemporary Marfil Cream Tongue & Groove Hydrolock Shower Wall PanelA subtle marble veining pattern in cream and soft beigeQuick, grout-free install, and can be cut to size and installed over old tilesMade from FSC-certified materials, 100% recyclable, and comes with a 30-year warrantyPlease note: To maintain Multipanel's 30-year warranty, store panels flat, not vertically or on trestles, and condition at room temperature for 48 hours before installation.Use Multipanel High Grab Panel Adhesive/Sealant. The warranty covers product failure but is void if installation and care guidelines are not followed.For a 100% watertight seal, apply silicone at all edges, whether using profiles, shower enclosures, or the Hydrolock system. Use offcuts behind sinks for a coordinated look, sealing all exposed edges with profiles and silicone.To clean, use warm water and mild detergent. Avoid scouring products, as improper cleaning may invalidate the warranty.
product.variant_name: Multipanel Contemporary Marfil Cream Tongue & Groove Hydrolock Shower Wall Panel - 2400mm x 1200mm

product.name: Brett Martin Plastic Industrial Deepstyle Gutter Angle
product.description:
Deepstyle 170mm is a high performance industrial rainwater system offering increased drainage capacity for larger commercial projects, factories, warehouses, farm buildings and apartments. The design features innovative CLIP & SEAL technology for ease of installation, superior sealing and exceptional reliability. Strong and durable, Deepstyle 170mm is manufactured from UV resistant PVC. The system’s robustness has been fully tested to BS EN 1462 Load Class H, whilst its unique formulation provides long-term weatherability for the systems high gloss gutter, fittings and downpipes. The system is available in Black and Grey.

170mm high performance industrial rainwater system with a greater drainage capacity
This large scale system enables larger roofs to be drained more efficiently and effectively
High gloss UV protected gutter and downpipes look better and last longer
All fittings feature factory fitted CLIP & SEAL technology for ease of installation
Allows larger roofs to be drained more efficiently and effectively
Tested to BE EN 1462 Load Class H and BS EN 607
Compatible with 110mm Industrial Downpipe System
10 year warranty

product.name: DEKTITE Diverter Red Silicone Pipe Flashing for Metal Roofs
product.description: The large base of this Red Silicone Pipe Flashing solution for metal roofs significantly reduces and diverts rainwater pooling. As a result, there’s no ponding where water can build up. This is usually caused by having a dip in the roof or damming where the water can build up behind any raised areas on the roof.Designed specifically for use on either very high or low roof pitches, this DEKTITE Diverter is compatible with roof pitches between 0° and 60° and is easy to install. Additionally, there’s no need to cut around the pipes. product.name: Ideal Heating Logic Air Monobloc 1Phase Air Source Heat Pump
product.description: The Ideal Heating Logic Air Monobloc 1Phase Air Source Heat Pump offers a compact, efficient, and low-carbon heating solution suitable for medium-sized homes or light commercial applications. Designed specifically for the UK climate, this monobloc unit integrates the heat pump and hydraulic components into a single outdoor unit, simplifying installation and reducing the need for refrigerant pipework.The unit operates with the eco-friendly R32 refrigerant and boasts a high Seasonal Coefficient of Performance (SCOP) of up to 5.19, ensuring excellent energy efficiency. It features Quiet Mark certification, ensuring minimal noise disruption. Smart weather-compensating controls and compatibility with solar PV systems further enhance its efficiency and integration into modern heating setups.Features & Benefits: Ideal Heating Logic Air Monobloc 1Phase Air Source Heat PumpIdeal for properties with high heating demandsProvides consistent warmth & hot waterCompatible with both radiator & underfloor heating systems offering flexibility

product.description: The FloPlast Solvent Cement is a high-strength adhesive designed for creating permanent, watertight joints in plastic plumbing systems. product.name: Belimo 3 Port Valve with a 240V Open/Close Actuator
product.description: This Belimo valve and actuator combo is a flexible, reliable solution for automating both hot and cold water systems. The actuator controls both the valve's opening and closing movement and comes in a range of standard imperial pipe diameters.With a nickel-plated hot-pressed brass valve housing, these valves can be relied on for long-lasting performance throughout the life of your system and can be retrofitted with other actuators in Belimo's extensive range. With the addition of this MAGNA1 variable speed circulator from Grundfos, you can deliver the required high energy efficiency, but with a reduced set of features. This pump can offer the perfect solution in a refurbishment situation where you need to either replace a Grundfos UPS product or one of the smaller models from the original Magna family. This pump is designed for circulating liquids in heating systems with variable flows where it is desirable to optimise the settings of the pump duty point, thus reducing energy costs. This MAGNA1 circulator comes complete with electronically controlled motors that are based on permanent magnet (PM) and stator technology. This circulator has been designed for circulating liquids in a wide range of light commercial and commercial applications including heating, air conditioning and cooling, domestic water, ground-source heat pump and solar heating systems. Features & Benefits: Grundfos MAGNA1 240 A RatedEuP Ready Variable Speed Circulator 240VProportional and constant pressure controlRange available for a maximum system pressure of 16 bar (PN16)Constant curve/constant speed dutyLong lifeMinimal maintenanceLow noise levelNine possible pump settingsSimple installationComplies with EuP 2013 and 2015 requirementsLow energy consumption Providing proportional and constant pressure control, this circulator does not require external motor protection and has a constant curve/speed duty. Insulating shells are supplied with single-head pumps for heating systems. This circulator has a wide temperature range where the liquid temperature and the ambient temperature are independent of each other. Product Specification0.1mm

product.name: Rockwool Rocklap 20mm Wall x 1m Foil Faced Pipe Insulation
product.description: The Rockwool mineral wool sections of stone wool pipe insulation (also known as pipe lagging) are comprised of a layer of factory applied foil which faces a self-adhesive lap. Produced pre-slit, they allow for quick and easy application. The sections provide acoustic and thermal insulation to heating, ventilation and air conditioning pipes that have temperatures in the 0C to 250C range.ROCKWOOL Rocklap insulation sections are an ideal solution for a large number of applications in industrial and residential settings alike. The self-adhesive lap allows them to snap onto the pipework to save you time. After that, all you need to do is simply use backing tape to seal the joint fully. 20mm thick and 1m in length, these insulation sections are ideal for pipes that are between 17mm and 60mm in diameter. All in all, they are extremely convenient and versatile.Features & Benefits: Rockwool Rocklap 20mm Wall x 1m Foil Faced Pipe InsulationPre-cut mineral wool insulation sections available in different widths20mm thickness x 1m lengthHigh performing and easy to installCompatible with pipes between 17mm and 60mm in diameter
product.variant_name: Rockwool Rocklap 20mm Wall x 1m Foil Faced Pipe Insulation - 22mm

product.name: Geberit Mapress Copper 90 Degree Gas Elbow
product.description: The Gerberit 'Mapress' system of fittings is a versatile, reliable, and time-saving solution for a wide variety of gas plumbing applications, including natural and liquefied gases. product.name: Honeywell Home V4073A Motorised Mid Position Diverter Valve
product.description:
The V4073A Valve has been designed to control the flow of water in domestic central heating systems, where both radiator and hot water cylinder circuits are pumped. It is typically suited for small to medium sized installations. The Mid-position Diverter Valve should be used in conjunction with a room thermostat and cylinder thermostat to provide full temperature control of a conventional, fully pumped central heating installation. When used in this way, the control system is known as Sundial Y Plan and the components can be connected together using the Sundial Plan Wiring Centre which has dedicated terminations and there is no need for a wiring diagram.

An alternative method of wiring is to use the Honeywell 10-way Junction Box (42002116-002) together with the Honeywell Sundial Plans Wiring Booklet.Features & Benefits: Honeywell Home V4073A Motorised Mid Position Diverter ValveSpring return actionThree position operationPowerhead replaceable without draining downManual lever for filling/draining downQuiet operation, minimal power consumptionProvides electrical output to boiler and/or pump

product.name: Multipanel Linda Barker Corten Elements Unlipped Shower Wall Panel

product.name: Vaillant ecoTEC Plus Combi Boiler
product.description: The Vaillant ecoTEC Plus Combi Boiler is part of Vaillant's new high-performance combi line, blending modern control features with a compact form factor.
