product.name: Spirotech SpiroCombi MB3 Magnetic Air and Dirt Separator
product.description: This SpiroCombi MB3 Magnetic Air Dirt Separator provides a solution for untreated systems where air may cause issues such as flow interruptions or even a complete system breakdown. Specially designed for the simultaneous removal of air and dirt, this SpiroCombi separator removes air, microbubbles and dirt particles from system water continuously. Separating the dirt that mainly consists of magnetite that accumulates wherever a magnetic field is present, this SpiroCombi separator is suitable for valves, heat exchangers, pipes, radiators, pumps and calorimeters. Reducing the costs associated with repairs, parts and downtime, this SpiroCombi separator minimises contamination which if untreated, leads to reduced system performance and therefore higher energy costs without any shut-off valves or bypass required. Features & Benefits: Spirotech SpiroCombi MB3 Magnetic Air and Dirt SeparatorRemoves circulating air and micro bubbles effectivelyVery small particles from 0.005mm are separated and removedDirt can be discharge while the system is in operationNo shut-off valves or bypass requiredConstant low-pressure dropExceptional guarantee

product.name: Geberit Mapress Copper Female Adaptor
product.description: This copper female iron adapter uses a simple pressing system that is adaptable to a variety of applications. These fittings are quick and reliable to process without the need for soldering which eliminates the risk of hot works.This female iron is sealed with a black seal ring made from Chlorobutyl Rubber (CIIR) which can be used with hot and cold potable water, heating water and cooling water. This Geberit copper fitting can be combined with other Gerberit Supply Systems and is made from a Cu-DHP alloy (phosphorus-deoxidised copper). It contains a white pressing indicator to test if the fitting is pressed correctly and a protection plug that prevents the fittings from becoming dirty. This copper fitting comes in a range of sizes from 15mm x 3/8” up to 54mm x 2” with the dimensions printed on the pressing indicator.Features & Benefits: Geberit Mapress Copper Female AdaptorSimple pressing system  Leaks if unpressed  Pressing indicator  Adaptable on a variety of applications  Quick and reliable fittings  No need for soldering  Variety of pipe uses  Cu-DHP alloy  Black Seal ring made from CIIR   Has a pressing socket with a transparent protection plug

product.description:
A range of traditionally designed, socketed aluminium downpipes. Connections between pipes and fittings are made with loose cast sockets, available with ears for fixing back to the wall. Pipes can also be fixed with a choice of base clips to give alternative projections.Applications

Ideal for traditionally designed buildings
Heritage downpipes are extruded sections with cast sockets
Compatible with all Alumasc aluminium gutter systems
Factory finished, in a choice of 1, 2 and 3 metre pipe lengths

Colours & Finishes

BBA approved polyester powder coatings
In-house powder coating facility
16 standard factory applied colours
BS or RAL colours available to special order
Can be supplied to resemble cast iron surface texture (black) to special order
Also available in plain mill finish for on-site painting

Performance

UK manufactured, extruded aluminium
Choice of circular, square and rectangular pipes
Lightweight, durable and non-corrodible
Easy to handle and fix
Life expectancy of aluminium: 40 years (rural/suburban areas); up to 25 years (industrial/marine areas)
Aluminium is 100% recyclable

Installation & Fixing

Pipe jointing by separate sockets gives maximum flexibility for installation
Simple fixing to wall by eared sockets or by a choice of pipe clips
Minimal maintenance requirements

product.name: Pegler Yorkshire Xpress Copper SG24 Gas Press Equal Tee
product.description: This Xpress Copper Gas Press equal tee ensures that safety is paramount by offering swift, flame-free installation alongside assuring consistent high-quality and performance for your commercial gas system. This Xpress equal tee has a temperature rating from -20°C to 70°C and a maximum working pressure of 1 bar inside and 5 bar outside. Available in a huge array of sizes and easy to install, these versatile copper tees are perfect for diverse applications, including domestic maintenance, refurbishment, new build and large-scale public works application. They can handle temperatures between 15°C to 95°C and maximum operating pressure of 16 bar. What’s more, these durable fittings are highly resistant to corrosion and require no regular aesthetic care or maintenance, making them an ideal fit-and-forget solution. That’s because they’re kitemarked and WRAS (Water Regulations Approval Scheme) approved, so you can rest assured they’ve been designed to the most rigorous standards. product.name: Mulitpanel Linda Barker Onyx Marble Tongue & Groove Hydrolock Shower Wall Panel
product.description: Indulge in the luxury of marble without breaking the bank with the Multipanel Linda Barker Onyx Marble Tongue & Groove Hydrolock Shower Wall Panel. Part of Multipanel's exclusive Linda Barker collection, this shower wall panel features a unique blend of soft, light neutral tones with dark grey marble veining patterns, giving it an authentic, high-end marble-like finish.With Hydrolock tongue and groove technology, installation is quick and straightforward with no mid-joints necessary, creating a seamless and discreet finish. The panel is also a decorative alternative to traditional wall tiles, eliminating the need for grout. The warranty covers product failure but is void if installation and care guidelines are not followed.For a 100% watertight seal, apply silicone at all edges, whether using profiles, shower enclosures, or the Hydrolock system. Use offcuts behind sinks for a coordinated look, sealing all exposed edges with profiles and silicone.To clean, use warm water and mild detergent. Avoid scouring products, as improper cleaning may invalidate the warranty.

product.name: Altecnic Reflex Horizontal Expansion Vessels for Potable Water
product.description: This Reflex horizontal expansion vessel is for potable water. Closed hot water circuits cannot compress water, so any rise in volume from temperature changes needs to be accommodated by an expansion vessel. When water is cold, the pre-charge pressure makes the bladder collapse until the pump starts up as the bladder inflates. The system temperature increases due to the associated increase in pressure and volume, in turn allowing expanded water to enter the bladder adding volume and lowering pressure. With the decrease in temperature decreases, the pre-charge pressure pushes water back to the main water circuit.Features & Benefits: Altecnic Reflex Horizontal Expansion Vessels for Potable WaterFor potable waterAccommodates volume changeSize options available

product.name: John Guest Speedfit Superseal Push-Fit Plastic Pipe Insert
product.description: Speedfit plastic pipe inserts by John Guest provide extra support to pipework when connecting a pipe to a fitting. Ideal for hot and cold water and central heating systems, they help keep pipe ends round, minimising any loss of shape which might occur when you’re cutting them. Thanks to the two additional O-ring seals, these inserts support pipework structure and facilitate a more effective seal between the outside diameter of the pipe and the O-ring. Available in sizes from 10mm to 28mm in diameter, Superseal inserts can be used with copper pipes designed to a BS EN 1057 standard and Speedfit barrier pipes designed to a BS7291 standard. They’re approved by the WRAS (Water Regulations Approval Scheme) and the BBA (British Board of Agrément), so you know they’re designed to the highest requirements.Features & Benefits: John Guest Speedfit Superseal Push-Fit Plastic Pipe InsertPush-fit, fully demountable plastic pipe inserts  Suitable for hot and cold water and central heating systems  Grip and seal connection  Lead-free  Corrosion-free  Available in 10mm-28mm sizes  WRAS and BBA approved

product.description: This Pegler Yorkshire Decorative Angled Thermostatic Radiator Valve is the perfect addition in an indirect open-vented or sealed water-filled central heating and/or indirect hot water system. product.name: Lindab Magestic Half Round Galvanised Steel Downpipe Branch
product.description:
Lindab Magestic is an improved galvanised steel material for rainwater system and standing seam applications. Magestic offers the same trusted Lindab product designs with a strengthened magnesium zinc alloy coating.Galvanised steel is already the most environmentally friendly material used in rainwater systems. Magestic has a reduced impact on zinc resources and less than 25% zinc run off into soils compared to hot dipped galvanised steel. New technology has allowed the material to be developed using magnesium to create a stable barrier to protect zinc’s porous structure against corrosion factors. Salt spray tests demonstrate the highest surface protection of any metallic coated steel. Magestic has more than twenty times the corrosion resistance of hot dipped galvanised steel. Unpainted metal gutters naturally weather organically adjusting to the installation environment. Magestic settles to an attractive dark grey metallic appearance within 3-5 years after installation.
Magestic corrosion in not influenced by the chlorine content of the environment. Natural exposure tests demonstrate more than three times the corrosion resistance of standard galvanisation in marine environments. Galvanised coatings migrate to repair red rust on cuts and scratches. Magnesium is more anodic than zinc making the sacrificial properties of Magestic more active than standard galvanisation.
Features

New elite, strengthed magnesium alloy coating
Highest surface protection of any metallic coated steel
Improved performance in coastal environments
Lowest price Lindab Rainwater System
10 Year Warranty

product.name: Pegler Yorkshire C9441 Press to Xpress Connector
product.description: This press to Xpress connector is part of the Pegler VSH power press range as a system that has been designed for thick wall steel pipe. product.name: Hudson Reed Chrome Triple Concealed Thermostatic Shower Valve
product.description: Complete your contemporary bathroom look with this minimalist sleek triple shower valve from Hudson Reed. Made from high-quality brass and ABS (Acrylonitrile Butadiene Styrene, a sturdy, toxin-free thermoplastic polymer resistant to strong impacts), it can be installed either horizontally or vertically to suit your overall décor. It provides highly accurate flow control and features thermostatic control to within +/- 2 to 3°C regardless of pressure fluctuations.And that's not all. Since the cartridge is fully reversible, it doesn't require re-plumbing even if hot and cold supplies are accidentally the wrong way around. All you have to do is remove it, turn 180° and replace! Highly versatile, these valves are suitable for use in a wide range of systems, including gravity-fed pumped, unvented high pressure and fully modulated combi-boilers.Features & Benefits: Hudson Reed Chrome Triple Concealed Thermostatic Shower ValveDurable triple shower valveHighly resistant to calcium build up and comes with a 20-year guaranteeDelivers excellent flow rates even at low pressurePlease note: Please take extra care during installation to avoid damaging the fittings.

product.name: Navien PEM750 R290 1Phase Monobloc Air-to-Water Heat Pump
product.description: The Navien PEM750 R290 1Phase Monobloc Air to Water Heat Pump is a compact, highly efficient heating solution designed for smaller homes or properties with low heat demand. Using R290 natural refrigerant, it offers an eco-friendly alternative to traditional heating systems while maintaining impressive performance. Its ability to reach flow temperatures up to 70°C makes it suitable for radiators as well as underfloor heating.With quiet operation, advanced controls, and full inverter technology, this model delivers smooth, responsive heating while keeping running costs low. Whether you're upgrading an older heating system or building a modern, energy-efficient home, the PEM750 provides reliable comfort with minimal environmental impact.Features & Benefits: Navien PEM750 R290 1Phase Monobloc Air-to-Water Heat PumpEco-friendly R290 refrigerant with high efficiency (SCOP up to 4.86)Delivers up to 70°C flow temperature for heating and hot waterQuiet 55 dB(A) operation with smart touch controls and app connectivity

product.name: Nabic 2 1/2 inch 500 High Lift Safety Valve
product.description: This NABIC 500 high lift safety valve is designed primarily for use on unvented hot water heating systems, where a high capacity, emergency steam relief capability is required. All wetted parts are manufactured from dezincification resistance materials. Designed and tested to BS EN ISO 4126-1 and WRAS approved, this safety valve has a resilient PTFE seating design with a high degree of seat tightness. This high lift safety valve has a drain plug fitted and a locked and sealed pressure setting. Offering easy inspection and cleaning, this safety valve has a high discharge capacity and diaphragm-protected parts. product.name: Worcester Bosch Compress 2000 AWF 1 Phase Air Source Heat Pump
product.description: The Worcester Bosch Compress 2000 AWF 1-Phase Air Source Heat Pump is a compact renewable heating solution designed for small homes and light commercial spaces. Using energy extracted from the outside air, even in low -20°C temperatures, it provides efficient heating with 4kW to 16kW outputs for properties with moderate heat demand. Operating on a standard single-phase supply, it is fantastic for typical residential installations with a lower running cost compared to three-phase systems.Highly efficient, the unit produces several units of heat for every unit of electricity consumed, supporting lower energy bills and improved comfort. product.name: Rockwool Rocklap 25mm Wall x 1m Foil Faced Pipe Insulation
product.description: The mineral wool pre-formed sections of stone wool pipe insulation (also known as pipe lagging) from ROCKWOOL Rocklap, which consist of a layer of factory-applied foil facing and a self-adhesive lap, are produced pre-slit to allow for easy application. The sections provide acoustic and thermal insulation to ventilation, heating and air conditioning pipes with temperatures from 0C to 250C. They measure 25mm thick and 1m in length, and they are suitable for pipes that are 17mm to 114mm in diameter, making them extremely versatile.The ROCKWOOL Rocklap insulation sections can be implemented in a wide range of applications in residential and industrial settings. Thanks to the self-adhesive lap, they simply snap onto the pipework. You can then use backing tape to fully seal the joint.Features & Benefits: Rockwool Rocklap 25mm Wall x 1m Foil Faced Pipe InsulationFor purchase in a range of widthsHigh performance foil covered mineral wool insulation sections suited to pipes 17mm to 114mm in diameter25mm thickness x 1m length

product.name: PS605 Bronze Thermal Circulation Valve
product.description: The PS605 Bronze Thermal Circulation Valve is a reliable and innovative solution for maintaining safe and efficient hot water circulation systems. Designed to automatically balance thermal flow and facilitate high-temperature disinfection, this valve ensures optimal system hygiene and safety. Pre-set to approximately 57°C, it effectively prevents bacterial growth within the 22-43°C range. With an automatic disinfection feature activated at water temperatures above 65°C, it provides an added layer of protection against harmful bacteria.Crafted from durable bronze and fitted with EPDM seals, the PS605 is built for long-lasting performance under a pressure rating of PN16. It features a convenient temperature selection dial, as well as isolation and drain functions for easy maintenance and operation. product.name: Alumasc Heritage Aluminium Circular Downpipe with Ears
product.description:
This is a round downpipe with socket ears. This round downpipe is manufactured from aluminium, and is part of a wide range of aluminium guttering products from Alumasc.
Connections between pipes and fittings are made with loose cast sockets, available with ears for fixing back to the wall. Pipes can also be fixed with a choice of base clips to give alternative projections.
Applications

Ideal for traditionally designed buildings
Heritage downpipes are extruded sections with cast sockets
Compatible with all Alumasc aluminium gutter systems
Factory finished, in a choice of 1, 2 and 3 metre pipe lengths

Colours & Finishes

BBA approved polyester powder coatings
In-house powder coating facility
16 standard factory applied colours
BS or RAL colours available to special order
Can be supplied to resemble cast iron surface texture (black) to special order
Also available in plain mill finish for on-site painting

Performance

UK manufactured, extruded aluminium
Choice of circular, square and rectangular pipes
Lightweight, durable and non-corrodible
Easy to handle and fix
Life expectancy of aluminium: 40 years (rural/suburban areas); up to 25 years (industrial/marine areas)
Aluminium is 100% recyclable

Installation & Fixing

Pipe jointing by separate sockets gives maximum flexibility for installation
Simple fixing to wall by eared sockets or by a choice of pipe clips
Minimal maintenance requirements

This is a round downpipe with socket ears. This round downpipe is manufactured from aluminium, and is part of a wide range of aluminium guttering products from Alumasc.
Connections between pipes and fittings are made with loose cast sockets, available with ears for fixing back to the wall. Pipes can also be fixed with a choice of base clips to give alternative projections.
Applications

Ideal for traditionally designed buildings
Heritage downpipes are extruded sections with cast sockets
Compatible with all Alumasc aluminium gutter systems
Factory finished, in a choice of 1, 2 and 3 metre pipe lengths

Colours & Finishes

BBA approved polyester powder coatings
In-house powder coating facility
16 standard factory applied colours
BS or RAL colours available to special order
Can be supplied to resemble cast iron surface texture (black) to special order
Also available in plain mill finish for on-site painting

Performance

UK manufactured, extruded aluminium
Choice of circular, square and rectangular pipes
Lightweight, durable and non-corrodible
Easy to handle and fix
Life expectancy of aluminium: 40 years (rural/suburban areas); up to 25 years (industrial/marine areas)
Aluminium is 100% recyclable

Installation & Fixing

Pipe jointing by separate sockets gives maximum flexibility for installation
Simple fixing to wall by eared sockets or by a choice of pipe clips
Minimal maintenance requirements
product.variant_name: Aluminium Guttering Round Downpipe Socket Eared 63mm x 1m - Black

product.name: John Guest Speedfit Female Coupler Tap Connector
product.description: This John Guest Speedfit tap connector has a push-fit plastic fitting with a grip and seal connection with stainless steel teeth and a main O-Ring seal. product.description: This John Guest Speedfit tap connector has a push-fit plastic fitting with a grip and seal connection with stainless steel teeth and a main O-Ring seal. product.name: Multipanel Linda Barker Bianca Luna Tongue & Groove Hydrolock Shower Wall Panel
product.description: Looking for a luxurious and stylish finish for your modern bathroom interiors? Look no further than the Multipanel Linda Barker Bianca Luna Tongue & Groove Hydrolock Shower Wall Panel. This stunning wall panel is designed to emulate the authentic natural beauty of marble, with a soft white tone brought to life with intricate grey and silver detailing that imitates the unique and captivating charm of marble veining. As part of Multipanel's exclusive Linda Barker collection, this beautiful and modern design takes inspiration from various natural elements and materials, such as wood, metal, and stone.The Hydrolock tongue and groove edge allows panels to be joined together without the use of mid-joints, creating a smooth, almost seamless surface. With an impressive 6mm tolerance, Hydrolock panels are easy to install, 11mm thick, and produce a great finish every time.Features & Benefits: Multipanel Linda Barker Bianca Luna Tongue & Groove Hydrolock Shower Wall PanelFully waterproof and easy to keep cleanCan be cut to size as well as installed over old tilesMade from FSC-certified materials, is 100% recyclable, and comes with a 30-year warrantyPlease note: To maintain Multipanel's 30-year warranty, store panels flat, not vertically or on trestles, and condition at room temperature for 48 hours before installation.Use Multipanel High Grab Panel Adhesive/Sealant. The warranty covers product failure but is void if installation and care guidelines are not followed.For a 100% watertight seal, apply silicone at all edges, whether using profiles, shower enclosures, or the Hydrolock system. Use offcuts behind sinks for a coordinated look, sealing all exposed edges with profiles and silicone.To clean, use warm water and mild detergent. Avoid scouring products, as improper cleaning may invalidate the warranty.

product.name: Pegler Yorkshire Xpress Copper S1S Press Slip Coupling
product.description: This Xpress copper press slip coupling is perfect for connecting copper pipes together. It uses a press tool method that doesn’t need any additional solders, adhesives, or hot works to install and utilises a slip feature that lets the fitting slide over the pipe. This means that your experience will be quick, safe, and easy without long preparation times. Not only does the clean internal bore mean less cleaning, but the copper structures also have no carbon deposits, internal solder, or flux residue – this lessens the risk of corrosion while simultaneously increasing longevity and durability. Xpress products are ideal for domestic maintenance and refurbishment, as well as new build and large-scale public-sector projects, and the systems don’t need to be ‘dry’ for effective jointing. This product is available in varied sizes from 15mm to 108mm.Features & Benefits: Pegler Yorkshire Xpress Copper S1S Press Slip CouplingNo localised annealing due to high-temperature work  Electrical continuity when jointed  Large variety of approvals including Kitemark, WRAS, and DVGW.

product.name: Altecnic Reflex Vertical Expansion Vessels For Potable Water
product.description: This Reflex vertical expansion vessel is for potable water and comes in various sizing options. Closed hot water circuits cannot compress water, meaning that rise in volume from temperature change has to be accommodated by an appropriate expansion vessel. For cold water, the pre-charge pressure causes the bladder to collapse until the pump begins as the bladder inflates. The system temperature increases from the pressure and volume, in turn allowing expanded water to flow into the bladder to add volume and lessen pressure. After the temperature decreases, the pre-charge pressure pushes water back to the main water circuit.Features & Benefits: Altecnic Reflex Vertical Expansion Vessels For Potable Water10 bar maximum pressureVarious sizesFor potable water

product.name: JTM DZR Straight Female Iron
product.description:
This sturdy JTM compression female iron features female threading for making easy connections between pipes. The compression fitting forms a solid joint when you tighten the nut, in turn compressing the ring onto the connected pipe or tube.
As a DZR fitting (Dezincification Resistant Brass), this compression female iron is perfect for applications that deliver and contain drinking water, including commercial and residential construction applications. DZR is highly resistant to corrosion with its lower zinc content, making it not only safe but also incredibly dependable and durable to withstand longevity use. DZR is also resistant to dezincification – which is the process of zinc corroding out of the brass. With this process removed, your compression female iron is far less likely to leak and once again ensures your fitting stays perfectly intact. Features & Benefits: JTM DZR Straight Female IronLong-lasting and cost-efficient  Easy-to-use threading system and simple installation process   A range of sizes available.

product.name: Mulitpanel Linda Barker Siena Marble Tongue & Groove Hydrolock Shower Wall Panel
product.description: With its stunning mottled pattern featuring light and dark grey tones, this  Linda Barker Siena Marble Tongue & Groove Hydrolock Shower Wall Panel from Multipanel features a design inspired by the unique character of natural marble, a much-sought-after decorative feature in bathrooms. Part of Multipanel's exclusive Linda Barker collection, this shower wall panel is designed by the renowned interior designer and is a decorative alternative to wall tiles, eliminating the need for grout.The Hydrolock tongue and groove edge allow the panels to be joined together without the use of mid-joints, creating a smooth and discreet finish. With an impressive 6mm tolerance, Hydrolock panels are easy to install and produce a great finish every time.Features & Benefits: Mulitpanel Linda Barker Siena Marble Tongue & Groove Hydrolock Shower Wall PanelBoasts a stunning mottled, matt marble-effect pattern featuring light and dark grey tonesLightweight panels are 11mm thick and can be cut to size and even installed over old tilesMade from FSC-certified materials, is 100% recyclable, and comes with a 30-year warrantyPlease note: To maintain Multipanel's 30-year warranty, store panels flat, not vertically or on trestles, and condition at room temperature for 48 hours before installation.Use Multipanel High Grab Panel Adhesive/Sealant. The warranty covers product failure but is void if installation and care guidelines are not followed.For a 100% watertight seal, apply silicone at all edges, whether using profiles, shower enclosures, or the Hydrolock system. Use offcuts behind sinks for a coordinated look, sealing all exposed edges with profiles and silicone.To clean, use warm water and mild detergent. Avoid scouring products, as improper cleaning may invalidate the warranty.
product.variant_name: Mulitpanel Linda Barker Siena Marble Tongue & Groove Hydrolock Shower Wall Panel - 2400mm x 1200mm

product.name: Grundfos MAGNA1 240 Variable Speed Single Head Circulator 240V
product.description:
This MAGNA1 circulator pump is designed for circulating liquids in heating systems with variable flows where it is desirable to optimise the setting of the pump duty point, thus reducing energy costs. This pump is also suitable for domestic hot-water systems.To ensure correct operation, it is important that the sizing range of the system falls within the duty range of the pump. This variable speed single head circulator is suitable for a range of heating systems including main pump, mixing loops, heating and air-conditioning. product.description: ProRad have a range of radiator designs, including Type 11 (K1), Type 21 (P+) and Type 22 (K2). Slimline single panel (Type 11) are great for small spaces due to their smaller footprint, whereas bigger units include two panels and fins that result in higher heat outputs (BTU) and an increase in size.Type 11 radiators feature a single convector (a single row of fins) and has an open back that is positioned facing the wall. product.name: Multipanel Classic Antique Marble Tongue & Groove Hydrolock Shower Wall Panel
product.description: The perfect addition to your bathroom or wet room walls, the waterproof Multipanel Classic Antique Marble Tongue & Groove Hydrolock Shower Wall Panel, part of the Classic collection, exudes a luxurious charm that brings a high-end style to your home. This means that you can enjoy a fantastic finish every time, without the need for mid-joints. Made from FSC-certified materials that are 100% recyclable. product.name: Alumasc Heritage Aluminium Circular Socket with Ears
product.description:
A range of traditionally designed, socketed aluminium downpipes. Connections between pipes and fittings are made with loose cast sockets, available with ears for fixing back to the wall. Pipes can also be fixed with a choice of base clips to give alternative projections.Applications

Ideal for traditionally designed buildings
Heritage downpipes are extruded sections with cast sockets
Compatible with all Alumasc aluminium gutter systems
Factory finished, in a choice of 1, 2 and 3 metre pipe lengths

Colours & Finishes

BBA approved polyester powder coatings
In-house powder coating facility
16 standard factory applied colours
BS or RAL colours available to special order
Can be supplied to resemble cast iron surface texture (black) to special order
Also available in plain mill finish for on-site painting

Performance

UK manufactured, extruded aluminium
Choice of circular, square and rectangular pipes
Lightweight, durable and non-corrodible
Easy to handle and fix
Life expectancy of aluminium: 40 years (rural/suburban areas); up to 25 years (industrial/marine areas)
Aluminium is 100% recyclable

Installation & Fixing

Pipe jointing by separate sockets gives maximum flexibility for installation
Simple fixing to wall by eared sockets or by a choice of pipe clips
Minimal maintenance requirements
product.variant_name: Aluminium Guttering Round Downpipe Eared Socket 63mm - Black

product.name: Adey MagnaClean DRX Magnetic Filter
product.description: The MagnaClean DRX magnetic filter by Adey is designed to maintain and restore the efficiency and performance of commercial heating systems by removing debris and black iron oxide sludge from the system. Suitable for in-line and side stream installations, it features a compact new design based on industry-proven magnetic filtration technologies and components. The filter consists of a unique magnetic belt which contains high-performing neodymium magnets wrapped around a precision-engineered stainless-steel canister. Thanks to this unique technology, it’s quick and easy to service, making it a convenient as well as highly effective solution.What’s more, only minimal space is needed around the filter, so it’s ideal for use where space is limited. MagnaClean DRX is a versatile product, which is available in 2”, 2½”, 3” and 4” pipe dimensions to help you meet the demands of various applications. It also comes supplied with EPDM (ethylene propylene diene monomer, a highly durable rummer compound) full-flange gaskets that guarantee robust sealing at high temperatures of up to 100°C.Features & Benefits: Adey MagnaClean DRX Magnetic FilterHelps restore heating system efficiency and performance  Effective capture of sludge  Easy to install and maintain  Suitable for in-line and side stream installations  Can be installed on vertical and horizontal pipe runs  Compact and compatible with all heating systems  Available in multiple pipe sizes  Automatic air vent  Maximum working pressure 16 bar

product.name: Multipanel Linda Barker Calacatta Marble Unlipped Shower Wall Panel
product.description: Transform your bathroom into a luxurious spa-like escape with the Multipanel Linda Barker Calcatta Marble Unlipped Shower Wall Panel. With a fully waterproof design, the Calcatta Marble panel features a crisp white base tone and intricate light grey veining pattern that allows you to enjoy the unique beauty of natural stone but at a fraction of the price.Part of Multipanel's exclusive Linda Barker collection, these beautiful, modern designs have been curated by the renowned interior designer, who has taken inspiration from various natural elements and materials, such as wood, metal and stone. The panels are 11mm thick and lightweight, making them quick and easy to install.Features & Benefits: Multipanel Linda Barker Calacatta Marble Unlipped Shower Wall PanelQuick and simple to install and can be cut to size as well as installed over old tiles100% recyclable, made from FSC-certified materials and has a 30-year warrantyPlease note: To maintain Multipanel's 30-year warranty, store panels flat, not vertically or on trestles, and condition at room temperature for 48 hours before installation.Use Multipanel High Grab Panel Adhesive/Sealant. Avoid scouring products, as improper cleaning may invalidate the warranty.

product.name: Spirotech SpiroCombi PN16 Steel Flanged Air and Dirt Seperator
product.description: This SpiroCombi Airt Dirt Separator is PN16 Steel Flanged and provides a solution for untreated systems where air may cause issues such as flow interruptions or even a complete system breakdown. Separating the dirt that mainly consists of magnetite that accumulates wherever a magnetic field is present, this SpiroCombi separator is suitable for valves, heat exchangers, pipes, radiators, pumps and calorimeters. Reducing the costs associated with repairs, parts and downtime, this SpiroCombi separator minimises contamination which if untreated, leads to reduced system performance and therefore higher energy costs without any shut-off valves or bypass required. Features & Benefits: Spirotech SpiroCombi PN16 Steel Flanged Air and Dirt Seperator110°C maximum temperatureOperating pressure 10 BarEnergy savingHighly efficient air and dirt removalQuick and easy cleaning without messUnique high-powered magnetProtects critical system componentsRemoves circulating air and micro bubbles effectivelyDirt can be discharged while the system is in operationConstant low-pressure drop

product.name: Zilmet Floor Standing Horizontal Vessels With Interchangeable Membrane
product.description: This Zimlet horizontal vessel is fantastic for irrigation pumps, centrifugal pumps, submersible pumps, and booster sets. The capacity of a bladder tank is greater than that of other storage tanks, although the same performance can be achieved with a smaller volume, which allows minimum pump starts and retains energy. With a  range of different sizes, you can find the right vessel for your needs.  The bladder is great for alimentary purposes and is fixed at both ends to prevent contact with the inner tank surface. ULTRA-PRO pressure tanks offer fantastic service as the bladder can be replaced with little trouble. The MIG welded carbon steel body has no internal rough spots or sharp edges.When the pump starts, water can enter the membrane tank as system pressure passes the pressure pre-charge with the whole capacity of the tank. Only usable water gets stored. The pressure in the chamber will reach the maximum system pressure and stop the pump, while the tank is filled to maximum capacity. Pressure in the airside will push water into the system when water is required. ULTRA-PRO tanks do not water log and deliver all possible water.Features & Benefits: Zilmet Floor Standing Horizontal Vessels With Interchangeable Membrane100% factory tested procedures and certified to PED 97/23/EC24 - 3000 litre capacityReplaceable bladderFor use with potable waterPainted externally with long-lasting epoxy powderMild steel or stainless steel flanges for aggressive water

Its compact and easy-to-install design makes it a practical solution for preventing airlocks and maintaining a fully functional heating system. product.name: John Guest Speedfit Push-Fit Stop End
product.description: Speedfit stop ends by John Guest are suitable for capping off pipework at termination points in hot and cold water and central heating system temporarily or permanently. Thanks to the push-fit technology, they’re quick and easy to fit – simply push them fully onto the pipe, and you’re done! Additionally, they’re fully demountable, so you can remove them just as quickly without the need for any tools. All it takes is pushing the collet towards the body of the stop end and pulling the pipe to release.These convenient fittings, which come in multiple sizes, feature a grip & seal collet with stainless steel teeth and a main O-Ring seal. Approved by the BSI (British Standards Institution) and the WRAS (Water Regulations Advisory Scheme), Speedfit stop ends are designed to the highest industry standards. They’re perfect when you need to turn on water when there’s an interruption in a job, for instance.Features & Benefits: John Guest Speedfit Push-Fit Stop EndSturdy push-fit and demountable stop end  Grip and seal connection  Lead-free and-non-toxic  Corrosion-free and no scale build-up  Safe, quick and easy to install  BSI and WRAS approved  Available in 10mm, 15mm, 22mm and 28 mm sizes

product.name: Multipanel Classic Cappuccino Stone Unlipped Shower Wall Panel
product.description: A striking member of Multipanel's Classic collection, the fully waterproof Multipanel Classic Cappuccino Stone Unlipped Shower Wall Panel is an eye-catching and highly decorative solution for your bathroom or wet room walls. Inspired by the dramatic beauty of natural stone, Cappuccino Stone comprises a magical blend of grey, beige, and light brown tones.The flexibility of the unlipped bare edge sets this panel apart, offering various fitting options to accommodate your unique design preferences. At 11mm thick, these panels stand as a testament to their robust construction, promising a long-lasting solution for your shower enclosure or wet room walls.Features & Benefits: Multipanel Classic Cappuccino Stone Unlipped Shower Wall PanelAn eye-catching and highly decorative wall panel inspired by the dramatic beauty of natural stoneCan be installed over existing tiles for time and cost savings100% recyclable, made from FSC-certified materials, and comes with a 30-year warrantyPlease note: To maintain Multipanel's 30-year warranty, store panels flat, not vertically or on trestles, and condition at room temperature for 48 hours before installation.Use Multipanel High Grab Panel Adhesive/Sealant. The warranty covers product failure but is void if installation and care guidelines are not followed.For a 100% watertight seal, apply silicone at all edges, whether using profiles, shower enclosures, or the Hydrolock system. Use offcuts behind sinks for a coordinated look, sealing all exposed edges with profiles and silicone.To clean, use warm water and non-abrasive mild detergent. Avoid scouring products, as improper cleaning may invalidate the warranty.

product.description:
The BA295S backflow preventer protects drinking water systems against back pressure, backflow and back siphonage. They can be used to protect against applications up to and including liquid category 4 in residential, commercial and industrial buildings. Typically, these valves are to be fitted inline to the supplies of commercial washing machines, restaurant kitchens and industrial processes. KIWA approved.

product.name: Softline Crystal Water Filter  Cartridges
product.description: These Softline Crystal water filter cartridges are available with a variety to choose from. The 901169 Crystal and the high specification 901183 Crystal+ drinking water filter kits comprise an integrated carbon filter/filter house, a tap and all pipework connections to connect to your mains supply with a push-fit filter for the Crystal kit and a twist release filter, push-fit valved head and integral bracket for the Crystal+ kit. The 901176 replacement cartridge for the crystal water filter kit has a nominal 3000-litre treatment capacity and a 6-month/3000-litre life, ensuring the filter change has a simple pull-off and push-in operation. Ideal for removing sediment and particles while improving taste and odour and inhibiting scale build-up, these Softline Crystal water filters reduce chlorine, herbicides, pesticides and industrial chemicals. More cost-effective than bottled water, these Crystal water filters are easy to change, do not require power and there is no need to cut off your water supply. product.name: Pegler Yorkshire Xpress Copper S21 Press Obtuse Elbow
product.description: This obtuse elbow provides a simple and efficient way to join copper tubes together in diverse applications, including domestic maintenance and refurbishment, new build and large-scale public sector projects. A completely heat-free jointing system, it requires no additional solders, adhesives, compounds, gas, hotworks permits or costly insurance, making it a safe and cost effective solution. It’s also incredibly versatile, as it’s available in multiple sizes, including large ones.Thanks to the press-fit technology, this sturdy copper fitting is quick and easy to install since it requires no complicated clamping techniques or long preparation procedures, and you don’t have to wait for the adhesive to dry. Last but not least, this high quality obtuse elbow is approved by the WRAS (Water Regulations Approval Scheme) and kitemarked, so you can be sure it’s manufactured to the highest standards. product.name: JTM Stainless Steel Air & Dirt Separator Chemical Dosing Pots
product.description: Dosing pots are required to feed liquid chemicals, such as corrosion inhibitors, into closed systems. These dosing pods by JTM allow for closed re-circulating hot or called water systems to be dosed on a regular or manual basis. Supplied complete with all valves, they consist of a stainless steel vessel with inlet (return) and outlet (flow) valves, a drain valve and a filling valve, steel tundish, air release valve, wall mounting brackets and a non-return valve (NRV). Fitted across flow and return lines, the dosing pods provide a means to annex a portion of the system water which can be drained away and replaced with the chemical to be dosed. When reconnected to the system, the chemical is flushed through. The dosing pots are fitted with large 1 inch valves, which ensure quick and easy action of the pot even in low flow/pressure conditions. product.name: Xpress Copper Chrome S12SCP Press Street Elbow
product.description: This S12SCP Press Street Elbow offers an array of benefits and unparalleled convenience for various plumbing applications. This advanced fitting ensures major savings in installation time and cost compared to traditional jointing methods. The heat free jointing system eliminates the need for solders, adhesives, compounds, gas, hot works permits, or costly insurance. With Xpress, you get clean, rapid, and safe jointing without complicated clamping techniques, lengthy preparation, or waiting for adhesives to dry.Safety is paramount with no naked flames required, reducing risks associated with high temperature working. The Xpress system ensures a perfectly clean internal bore, minimizing the need for additional finishing or cleaning. There are no carbon deposits, internal solder runs, or flux residues, significantly reducing corrosion risks. Additionally, the system doesn't need to be dry for effective jointing. Xpress fittings are widely approved, including Kitemark, WRAS, and DVGW, and they assure electrical continuity upon completing the jointing process. Ideal for domestic maintenance, refurbishment, new builds, and large-scale public sector projects, Xpress fittings provide unmatched versatility and reliability.Features & Benefits: Xpress Copper Chrome S12SCP Press Street ElbowMajor savings, reduced installation time and costHeat free jointing, no additional solders, adhesives, or flames requiredWide approvals, includes Kitemark, WRAS, and DVGW certifications

product.name: Geberit Mapress Carbon Steel 90 Degree Elbow
product.description: The Gerbit 'Mapress' system of carbon steel pipes and fittings is a versatile, reliable, and time-saving solution for a huge variety of plumbing applications, including water, compressed air, heating and cooling. Combining easy installation, secure fitting, and impressive longevity, the Mapress system of fittings is a compelling and cost-effective alternative to traditional, time-consuming soldering.These sturdy carbon steel 90° elbows integrate seamlessly and easily into the Mapress line and are case-in-point for the time-saving technology on show with the system. The pressing procedure for these elbows is around twice as fast as soldering, with no open flames required, using cold deformation of both the fitting and the pipe itself. Fast connection, fast installation, and fast identification of leaks during pressure testing, and the Mapress carbon steel system stands out for your next plumbing project, no matter the application.Features & Benefits: Geberit Mapress Carbon Steel 90 Degree ElbowFast, flame-free installation up to twice as fast as traditional soldering techniquesHuge variety of fittings availableRange covers water, heating, cooling, and compressed air applicationsPressing indicators make installation easy and fuss-free

product.name: John Guest Speedfit Chrome Plated Ball Valve

product.name: Mira JUMP White Electric Shower
product.description: The Mira Jump White Electric Shower offers versatile installation with up to 36 combinations, making it perfect for replacing existing electric showers in bathrooms, wet rooms, and en-suites. Its sleek, modern design features easy-to-use dials for temperature and power settings, including low, eco, and high options. The eco setting is ideal for energy-saving, while the on/off push button lets you keep your preferred settings. Mira's Clearscale technology reduces limescale build-up by up to 50%, ensuring reliable performance.Complete with an adjustable showerhead offering four spray settings, this shower caters to different preferences, from a gentle spray to a powerful jet. product.name: John Guest Speedfit Flexi Hose Monobloc Mixers
product.description: These push-fit flexi hoses are suitable for the connection of plastic and copper pipe to a female mixer tap and have been designed, manufactured and assembled in the UK by John Guest Speedfit. These hoses are ideal for the connection to monobloc mix taps. To make a connection, simply push the fitting fully onto the pipe and screw the thread into the bloc. These hoses have offset spanner locations to ease installation. If the need arises to demount the connection, push the collet towards the body of the fitting and pull the pipe to release. These fittings ensure an easier working environment in confined places and remove the need for hot works on site. Installation can be reduced by around 40% against traditional fixing methods. Features & Benefits: John Guest Speedfit Flexi Hose Monobloc MixersSold in pairsPush-fit and demountable connectionsWRAS approved6 Bar at 65°CRange of sizes availableFor the connection of plastic and copper pipe to a female monobloc mixer tapEasy to work with in confined placesRemoves the need for hot works on siteThe strictest control is maintained by virtue of the fact that design and manufacture are carried out in modern purpose-built manufacturing centres in west London and at Maidenhead in Berkshire. Maintaining control over the whole process from initial tool design and tool making through to final assembly and testing ensures that these monobloc mixer hoses are produced to the highest quality. John Guest Speedfit believe that it is this commitment to quality that has led to it receiving awards from many of the world’s leading testing and approvals organisations. Please note: With all plastic pipes, the relevant manufacturer’s insert is required.These monobloc mixer hoses are not suitable for central heating systems.

product.name: ESBE Valves ATA212 Draught Regulator with Immersion Pocket
product.description:
This series ATA200 draught regulator is a reliable and efficient control device for regulating the temperature of solid fuel boilers. The thermostatic control head senses the temperature and, through a lever and chain, adjusts the position of the air vent, thereby regulating the combustion air supply to the boiler. The draught regulator is fully adjustable within the range of 35–95 degrees Celsius. The draught regulator is connected directly to the boiler waterway through a threaded immersion pocket.Features & Benefits: ESBE Valves ATA212 Draught Regulator with Immersion PocketReliable control for solid fuel boilersThermostatic head measures and adjusts the air vent, controlling temperatureEfficiently regulates air supplyFully adjustable, with a temperature range of 35–95 degrees CelsiusProduct SpecificationESBE

product.name: Ideal Vogue Max Combi Boiler with Ideal System Filter
product.description: The Ideal Vogue Max Combi Boiler with Ideal System Filter combines premium performance and built-in protection in one package. It's a wall-hung condensing boiler delivering both central heating and domestic hot water. Its composite outer casing conceals a stainless-steel heat exchanger, and thanks to the inclusion of a system filter, this boiler helps safeguard against debris and sludge, a key factor in maximising lifespan and reliability.For installers, the Vogue Max is designed to save time and reduce issues. It boasts a low lift weight, pre-wired mains lead, and push-fit flue collar, simplifying on-site installation. The integral system filter further means you don't need to source and install a separate filter, ensuring the system is clean from day one.Features & Benefits: Ideal Vogue Max Combi Boiler with Ideal System FilterBacklit 3.5-inch LCD full colour displayMulti-function buttons for simplified end user operationErP A Rated for Heating & Hot WaterPlease note: It is a legal requirement to have your boiler installed by a certified Gas Safe installer. Please do not attempt to install if you don't have the correct certification.Please check the correct boiler type has been ordered before opening the box. Returns can only be accepted if the packaging is unopened and undamaged.If once the boiler has been installed you notice something wrong, please contact your Gas Safe installer first and they'll work with the manufacturer to resolve it under the warranty.There is a 15% restocking fee that applies to most returns.

product.name: Plasson Pipe Liner
product.description: This pipe liner can be used for a variety of pipes to maintain strength and integrity. Ideal for conveying water and other fluids in urban and inter-urban infrastructures, industrial, mining, landscape and farming applications. Made for joining polyethylene (PE) pipes, this push-fit pipe liner has a working pressure of up to 16 bar.Suitable for potable water applications and withstanding sub-zero temperatures, this pipe liner is available in a range of metric sizes from 20mm up to 63mm. This WRAS approved fitting has a captive o-ring seal which provides long-lasting protection against leakage and does not require tightening to achieve a full seal.Features & Benefits: Plasson Pipe LinerSuitable in rural and municipal areas, mining, industry, agriculture and communication lines  Polyacetal split rings and NBR o-rings supplied as standard  Suitable for use on potable water, withstanding sub-zero temperatures  Working pressure of up to 16 bar  Available in a range of metric sizes  WRAS approved  Cost-effective and affordable  Low maintenance once installed without the need for tightening

product.name: JTM WRAS Press M Profile Equal Tee
product.description: This sturdy M Profile tee from JTM is made of copper and suitable for use in HVAC (heating, ventilation and air conditioning) and hot and cold drinking water applications. It’s quick and easy to install with the help of an M Profile press machine and is highly resistant to oxidisation and corrosion. This fitting can be used with hard, half-hard and soft copper tube manufactured to EN 1057 standards, making it very versatile. What’s more, it’s available in a large number of diameter sizes that range from 15mm to 76mm, with those up to 54mm featuring a specifically designed O-ring with leak detection indicators. product.name: Scalemaster Electrolytic Gold Limescale Inhibitor
product.description:
The Scalemaster Electrolytic Gold Limescale Inhibitor is a cost-effective and maintenance-free solution for reducing limescale build-up in domestic water systems. Designed for easy installation directly onto copper or plastic pipework, this passive device works by altering the structure of scale-forming minerals in the water, making them less likely to adhere to pipes, heating elements, and appliances. It provides effective protection for combi boilers, water heaters, showers, and other hot water systems, extending their lifespan and maintaining efficiency.
Constructed with high-quality materials, the Electrolytic Gold model offers enhanced durability and consistent performance without the need for power supply or ongoing maintenance. Its compact design makes it suitable for installation in tight spaces.. Ideal for homeowners seeking a reliable way to manage hard water issues without chemicals or salt.
Features & Benefits: Scalemaster Electrolytic Gold Limescale InhibitorScalemaster Patented TechnologySolder FittingDifferent sizes available
Standards & CertificationWRAS Approved

UK manufactured

product.name: Plasson Concentric Meter Mount Kit With Drain Off
product.description: This high quality internal meter mount kit with drain off by Plasson is part of a comprehensive solution that provides safe and reliable water connections. Suitable for copper, PEX (cross-linked polyethylene) and polybutylene PB) piping, this robust PP (polypropylene) meter mount kit conveniently comes with a built-in drain valve to allow excess water vapor to escape into the atmosphere. product.name: Reliance Water Controls 315i Series Commercial Pressure Reducing Valve
product.description: The 315i Series of pressure reducing valves by RWC are ideal for protecting water supply installations against excess supply pressures and fluctuating mains supplies that might otherwise damage your plumbing system. They feature an easy-to-read unique indicator that can identify set pressure without a pressure gauge. These robust valves are suitable for use in both hot and cold supplies with pressure up to 25 bar and maximum temperature of 70°C. What’s more, they’re adjustable between 1-6 bar and can be installed in any orientation, making them a convenient solution. Thanks to the drop tight valve, pressure under flow and no flow conditions is controlled securely. These sturdy valves are made from DZR (dezincification resistant) brass for high durability, designed to a strict BSEN 1567 Water Pressure Reducing Valves and Combination Water Reducing Valves standard and approved by the WRAS (Water Regulations Approval Scheme), so you can be sure they’re of the highest quality.Features & Benefits: Reliance Water Controls 315i Series Commercial Pressure Reducing ValveRobust DRZ pressure reducing valves  Easy-to-read pressure indicator  Can be installed in any orientation  Single-piece, easy to replace cartridge  Fully serviceable integral strainer  Suitable for cold supplies  Designed to BSEN 1567 & WRAS approved

product.name: John Guest Speedfit Flexi Hose Plastic Wingnut - 300mm
product.description: This hand-tighten-only flexi hose is suitable for the connection of plastic or copper pipe onto a male thread appliance such as a tap and has been designed, manufactured and assembled in the UK by John Guest Speedfit. The flexi hose with an “SV” also features a valve to isolate the water supply.On one end, this hose features a push-fit connection for a supply pipe and on the other end, there is a plastic nut which can be hand tightened onto a tap or male thread. If the need arises to demount the pipe, simply push the collet towards the body of the fitting and pull the pipe to release. Installation can be reduced by around 40% against traditional fixing methods. Features & Benefits: John Guest Speedfit Flexi Hose Plastic Wingnut - 300mmSold in singles6 Bar at 65°CPush-fit and demountable connectionsWRAS approvedPVC hose materialRange of sizes availableFor the connection of plastic or copper pipe onto a male thread applianceSpeedfit x union nutPlastic wingnutHand tightened The strictest control is maintained by virtue of the fact that design and manufacture are carried out in modern purpose-built manufacturing centres in west London and at Maidenhead in Berkshire. Maintaining control over the whole process from initial tool design and tool making through to final assembly and testing ensures that this flexi hose is produced to the highest quality. John Guest Speedfit believe that it is this commitment to quality that has led to it receiving awards from many of the world’s leading testing and approvals organisations. Please note: With all plastic pipes, the relevant manufacturer’s insert is required.This flexi hose is not suitable for central heating systems.

product.name: Rubaflex Class O Self-Seal - 9mm
product.description: Perfect for plumbing, heating, and air conditioning applications, Rubaflex Class O self-seal offers a cut-to-length process of pipe insulation (also known as pipe lagging). It includes adhesive tapes that are simple to understand and quick to use, in turn making for a competitively fast installation time and minimising the need for various adhesives. With Rubaflex self-seal, the adhesive is provided for you.Made from an elastomeric foam that is coated with a black polymeric surface, this product is durable and resistant which makes it ideal for outdoor applications. Not only is it UV stable and waterproof, but it is available in several size varieties. Each length is 2m long but remains easy to cut down to the length necessary for your application - this makes it user-friendly and adaptable for multiple purposes, whether it be outdoor piping or indoor refrigeration, heating, plumbing, or air conditioning systems. Features & Benefits: Rubaflex Class O Self-Seal - 9mmPerforms well at temperatures between -45C and +110C  Cuts down on installation time and costs  Manufactured to European standards.

product.name: Geberit Mapress 90 Degree Copper Elbow
product.description: The Gerberit 'Mapress' system of fittings is a versatile, reliable, and time-saving solution for a wide variety of plumbing applications, including water, gas, compressed air, heating and cooling. Combining easy installation, secure fitting, and impressive longevity, the Mapress system of fittings is a compelling and cost-effective alternative to traditional, time-consuming soldering.These copper 90° elbows integrate seamlessly and easily into the Mapress line and are case-in-point for the time-saving technology on show with the system. product.name: Vaillant EcoFit Pure Open Vent Natural Gas Boiler
product.description: The Vaillant EcoFit Pure Open Vent Natural Gas Boiler is the perfect fit for a smaller home where space is at a premium. The top and rear flue options on all models provide the flexibility to install this boiler in various property types, ensuring it suits your specific requirements. Its compact and cupboard-friendly design offers a small footprint, granting you the freedom to place it wherever you prefer.With a high-specification aluminium heat exchanger, this boiler is built to last, easy to maintain and efficient, ultimately reducing energy bills. product.name: Altecnic Pressure Reducing Valve
product.description: The Series 535 range of high performance dial-up pressure reducing valves from Altecnic is designed for hot and cold systems in semi-commercial and industrial applications. They’re pre-adjustable, so you can set them at a required discharge pressure between 1 and 6 bar before installation with the help of the adjustment knob with pressure setting indicator. For greater convenience, the internal cartridge and control knob mechanism come assembled as one unit, making it easy to remove for inspection, cleaning and maintenance. Thanks to the compensated seat design of these pressure reducing valves, the set downstream pressure is independent of upstream pressure variations. In addition, the hydraulic profile makes it entirely possible to achieve low pressure losses even when a large number of outlets are open. The control stem housing of the cartridge consists of a highly adhesion-resistant plastic material, which helps prevent the formation of scale deposits forming. Available in multiple sizes, these valves operate at a maximum inlet pressure of 25 bar at a maximum temperature of 40C°. Features & Benefits: Altecnic Pressure Reducing ValveHigh performance DZR brass pressure reducing valves  Suitable for semi-commercial and industrial applications  Easy to install, clean and maintain  Outlet adjustment range of 1 - 6 bar  Maximum inlet pressure of 25 bar  WRAS approved
product.variant_name: Altecnic Series 535 Pressure Reducing Valve - 1/2 inch

product.name: Floplast Solvent Weld Waste Pipe
product.description: These sturdy plastic waste pipes from Floplast are ideally suited for connections from sanitary applications to a soil stack or back inlet drain gully. They’re light and easy to handle yet extremely durable and cost-effective. What’s more, they come with a consistent high gloss finish and colour in either black or white and require virtually no maintenance. The soil pipes are available in 3mtr and 1.5mtr lengths and inner diameter sizes of 32mm to 50mm, making them a versatile solution suitable for most projects. These waste pipes can carry liquids with a maximum temperature of 76°C, with intermittent discharges of up to 100°C. They’re designed to strict BS EN 1455-1:2000 standards, rigorously tested by the BSI (British Standards Institution) and kitemarked, so you know they’re of the highest quality. product.description: This range of MaxxFlo Flue options is well suited to MaxxFlo EVO water heaters, particularly the 90kW and 120kW models. product.name: Multipanel Contemporary Marfil Cream Unlipped Shower Wall Panel
product.description: Step into a world of affordable luxury with the Multipanel Marfil Cream Unlipped Shower Wall Panel, a charming design that makes up part of the Contemporary collection. It showcases a graceful fusion of cream and soft beige tones, adorned with an authentic stone finish. The subtle marble veining pattern adds a touch of opulence, creating a spa-like oasis in your bathroom or wet room.This panel is designed to offer flexibility in fitting options. Its unlipped bare edge provides a creative alternative to traditional wall tiles, eliminating the hassle of grouting and providing a seamless look. These lightweight panels are 11mm thick, easy to install and can be mounted over existing tiles.Features & Benefits: Multipanel Contemporary Marfil Cream Unlipped Shower Wall PanelDelicate marble veining pattern adds a touch of opulence to your roomQuick to install and can be cut to size100% recyclable, made from FSC-certified materials and has a 30-year warrantyPlease note: To maintain Multipanel's 30-year warranty, store panels flat, not vertically or on trestles, and condition at room temperature for 48 hours before installation.Use Multipanel High Grab Panel Adhesive/Sealant. The warranty covers product failure but is void if installation and care guidelines are not followed.For a 100% watertight seal, apply silicone at all edges, whether using profiles, shower enclosures, or the Hydrolock system. Use offcuts behind sinks for a coordinated look, sealing all exposed edges with profiles and silicone.To clean, use warm water and non-abrasive mild detergent. Avoid scouring products, as improper cleaning may invalidate the warranty.

product.name: Geberit Mapress Copper Gas Coupling
product.description: The Gerberit 'Mapress' system of fittings is a flexible, robust, and time-saving solution for a huge variety of challenging gas plumbing applications, including natural and liquefied gases. Combining straightforward installation, secure fitting, and impressive longevity, the Mapress system of fittings is a cost-effective alternative to traditional, time-consuming soldering.These copper gas couplings integrate simply and reliably into the Mapress line and are case-in-point for the time-saving technology on show with the system. The pressing procedure for these couplings is around twice as fast as soldering, with no open flames required, using cold deformation of both the fitting and the pipe itself. Fast connection, fast installation, and fast identification of leaks during pressure testing, and the Mapress system stands out for your next plumbing project, no matter the application.Features & Benefits: Geberit Mapress Copper Gas CouplingFast, flame-free installation up to twice as fast as traditional soldering techniquesHuge variety of fittings availableIdeal for natural and liquefied gas applicationPressing indicators make installation easy and fuss-free

product.name: John Guest Speedfit Flexi Hose Plastic Wingnut With Service Valve  - 15mm x 1/2 inch
product.description:
This hand-tighten-only flexi hose is suitable for the connection of plastic or copper pipe onto a male thread appliance such as a tap and has been designed, manufactured and assembled in the UK by John Guest Speedfit. The flexi hose with an “SV” also features a service valve to isolate the water supply.On one end, this hose features a push-fit connection for a supply pipe and on the other end, there is a plastic nut which can be hand tightened onto a tap or male thread. If the need arises to demount the pipe, simply push the collet towards the body of the fitting and pull the pipe to release. Installation can be reduced by around 40% against traditional fixing methods.Features & Benefits: John Guest Speedfit Flexi Hose Plastic Wingnut With Service Valve  - 15mm x 1/2 inchSold in singles6 Bar at 65°CPush-fit and demountable connectionsWRAS approvedPVC hose materialRange of sizes availableFor the connection of plastic or copper pipe onto a male thread applianceSpeedfit x union nutThe strictest control is maintained by virtue of the fact that design and manufacture are carried out in modern purpose-built manufacturing centres in west London and at Maidenhead in Berkshire. Maintaining control over the whole process from initial tool design and tool making through to final assembly and testing ensures that this flexi hose is produced to the highest quality. John Guest Speedfit believe that it is this commitment to quality that has led to it receiving awards from many of the world’s leading testing and approvals organisations. Please note: With all plastic pipes, the relevant manufacturer’s insert is required.
This flexi hose is not suitable for central heating systems.

product.name: Geberit Mapress Copper 45 Degree Street Elbow
product.description: These 45° street elbows are part of Geberit's popular 'Mapress' system of fittings, a versatile solution for a wide variety of plumbing applications. Combining easy installation, secure fitting, and impressive longevity, the Mapress system of fittings is a compelling and cost-effective alternative to traditional, time-consuming soldering.These copper fittings integrate seamlessly into the Mapress line and are case-in-point for the time-saving technology on show with the system. product.name: Grundfos UPS2 Light Commercial Pump
product.description:
Grundfos high efficiency UPS2 circulator pumps feature advanced control modes which allow for the adjustment of their performance to the specific system requirements in one- and two-pipe heating systems. These sturdy, versatile pumps are made of cast iron and are suitable for commercial heating as well as domestic hot water recirculation. Their motor is designed with the use of permanent-magnet and compact-rotor ECM (Electronically Commutated Motor, which is highly efficient) technology, which facilitates low energy consumption as well as silent operation and is compliant with the ErP directive No 641/2009. They offer both fixed speed and proportional pressure settings. Grundfos UPS2 pumps have a maximum operating pressure of up 10 bar and can deal with a flow rate of 5.7 m3/h. Models 25-80 (with a 1 1/2" connection) and 32-80 (with a 2" connection) are available. They’re compact, with a port-to-port length of 180mm, which makes them an excellent replacement for older models that’s easy to install in tight places.Features & Benefits: Grundfos UPS2 Light Commercial PumpHigh performance cast iron circulator pumpsEEI Product SpecificationGrundfos

product.name: Worcester Greenstar 2000 Combi Boiler
product.description: The Worcester Greenstar 2000 Combi Boiler is built for small to medium homes needing reliable heating and instant hot water without the need for a tank or cylinder. It's compact which lets you tuck it neatly into kitchen cupboards or tight plant rooms. Despite its size, it maintains strong performance, capable of handling simultaneous use while adjusting output down to optimise efficiency.To assist with layout flexibility, it supports flue runs up to 9m horizontal or 12m vertical (in 60/100mm flue) while still meeting manufacturer clearances. It also features Worcester's Quick Tap water-saving function, Quiet Mark certification, and compatibility with a wide range of smart and RF controls.Features & Benefits: Worcester Greenstar 2000 Combi BoilerSimple controls, easy to use to manage your heatingNo wasting water waiting for it to heat upErP A Rated for Heating & Hot WaterPlease note: It is a legal requirement to have your boiler installed by a certified Gas Safe installer. product.name: Altecnic Reflex Expansion Vessel For Heating System - 8l up to 800l
product.description: The Reflex nitrogen-filled heating expansion vessel range by Altecnic is suitable for use with most heating or cooling systems. The vessels are manufactured to strict PED 97/23/EC Directive and BS EN 13831:2007 'Closed expansion vessels with built in diaphragm for installation in water' standards and tested according to the Pressure Systems Directive. They're available in a wide range of sizes, from 8 litres to more than 800 litres, making them a versatile, convenient solution. The vessels are made by welding the sections together, resulting in a sturdy, reliable structure suitable for internal pressures up to 3 bar for smaller sizes and 6 bar for larger sizes as well as flow temperatures of up to 120°C. They feature a non-replaceable diaphragm and grey-coated epoxy.But that's not all! Reflex vessels have low glass permeability and are resistant to ethylene or propylene glycol mixtures. In addition, there are many benefits to using nitrogen in the vessels. To begin with, nitrogen improves the vessel life span by reducing corrosion inside the vessel and prevents loss of pre-charge pressure. It also permeates through rubber slower than oxygen and is far less reactive to both steel and aluminium, creating fewer debris inside the vessel. Last but not least, nitrogen does not degrade rubber, prolonging the membrane life.Features & Benefits: Altecnic Reflex Expansion Vessel For Heating System - 8l up to 800lDurable nitrogen-filled heating expansion vessels  Consist of a carbon steel shell with carbon steel connections and synthetic rubber diaphragm  Powder Epoxy coating  1.5 bar factory pre-charge  Available in 8l to 800l+ sizes  Maximum vessel temp of 70°CPlease note: 800l+ capacity available, please call for more info.

product.name: Hudson Reed Chrome Triple Concealed Thermostatic Shower Valve with Diverter
product.description: This minimalist sleek triple shower valve with diverter from Hudson Reed is manufactured to the highest standards from top quality brass and ABS (Acrylonitrile Butadiene Styrene, a sturdy, toxin-free thermoplastic polymer resistant to strong impacts). It offers accurate flow control and allows you to have precise thermostatic control to +/- 2 to 3°C regardless of pressure fluctuations. Thanks to the full thermal protection, you don't have to worry about scalding in case the cold water accidentally shuts off.Smartly designed, you can fit this highly versatile valve either horizontally or vertically to suit your bathroom design and it's suitable for a variety of systems, including gravity-fed pumped, unvented high-pressure and fully modulated combi-boilers. The valve is resistant to calcium buildup and since the cartridge is fully reversible, doesn't require re-plumbing even if hot and cold supplies are connected the wrong way around. The process is a simple as removing the cartridge, turning it 180° and replacing!Features & Benefits: Hudson Reed Chrome Triple Concealed Thermostatic Shower Valve with DiverterSleek contemporary triple thermostatic shower valve with diverterExcellent flow rates even at low pressure20-year guaranteePlease note: Please take extra care during installation to avoid damaging the fittings.

product.name: Multipanel Linda Barker Graphite Elements Unlipped Shower Wall Panel
product.description: Fully waterproof, the Multipanel Linda Barker Graphite Elements Unlipped Shower Wall Panel is a stunning choice for any wet environment. Featuring a textured surface and an array of dark and light grey tones that create an authentic graphite-like appearance, this panel is a decorative alternative to wall tiles that won't require grout. Plus, with its unlipped bare edge, it provides flexibility in fitting options.Part of Multipanel's exclusive Linda Barker collection, these beautiful, modern designs take inspiration from various natural elements and materials, such as wood, metal and stone. All panels are 11mm thick and lightweight, making them durable and easy to handle. They're also quick and easy to install and can even be installed over old tiles.Features & Benefits: Multipanel Linda Barker Graphite Elements Unlipped Shower Wall PanelFeatures a textured surface and an array of dark and light grey tones that create an authentic graphite-like appearanceQuick and simple to install and can be cut to size100% recyclable, made from FSC-certified materials and has a 30-year warrantyPlease note: To maintain Multipanel's 30-year warranty, store panels flat, not vertically or on trestles, and condition at room temperature for 48 hours before installation.Use Multipanel High Grab Panel Adhesive/Sealant. Avoid scouring products, as improper cleaning may invalidate the warranty.

product.name: Nabic 1 inch 500 High Lift Safety Valve
product.description:
This NABIC 500 high lift safety valve is designed primarily for use on unvented hot water heating systems, where a high capacity, emergency steam relief capability is required. All wetted parts are manufactured from dezincification resistance materials. 
Designed and tested to BS EN ISO 4126-1 and WRAS approved, this safety valve has a resilient PTFE seating design with a high degree of seat tightness. It has a locked and sealed pressure setting. Offering easy inspection and cleaning, this safety valve has a high discharge capacity and diaphragm-protected parts. Features & Benefits: Nabic 1 inch 500 High Lift Safety Valve Easy inspection and cleaningHigh discharge capacityResilient PTFE seating designDiaphragm protected partFor use on unvented hot water heating systemsPressure setting locked and sealedPadlock available (complies with M&E3)Available with Viton seat design

product.name: Spirotech SpiroVent Solar Air Separator
product.description: This SpiroVent Air Separator is a deaerator that should always be installed at the hottest point within a system. In the case of a heating system, for example, this is the point where the water exits the boiler. In the case of a cooling system, it is in the return before the chiller unit. When installed in the correct location, this SpiroVent has the capability to deaerate your entire system as it can make the water absorptive. product.description: For a stylish and waterproof solution for your shower area, look no further than the Multipanel Linda Barker Concrete Elements Tongue & Groove Hydrolock Shower Wall Panel. product.name: Pegler Yorkshire PS550 PN16 DZR Press Ended Lever Ball Valve
product.description: This DZR brass ball valve, from Pegler Yorkshire, is supplied with a full-bore level and Xpress ends for copper/carbon steel/stainless steel tube and is available in a range of sizes. The 1/4 inch to 2 inch body and end piece of the ball valve are made from chrome-plated, forged brass while the 2 1/2 inch to 4 inch body, end piece and ball of the valve are manufactured from chrome-plated, gravity die-cast brass. The 1/4 inch to 1/2 inch ball of the valve is made from a chrome-plated, brass bar while the 3/4 inch to 2 inch ball of the valve is chrome-plated, forged brass.Features & Benefits: Pegler Yorkshire PS550 PN16 DZR Press Ended Lever Ball ValveFull-bore levelXpress ends for copper/carbon steel/stainless steel tubeRange of sizesBrass constructionGas applicationFeaturing a brass (EL) washer, external stem and sleeve, this ball valve also includes a steel (EL) fixing screw, EPDM end connection ‘O’ ring, nickel plated brass security screws, aluminium painted tee handle, zinc plated steel self-locking nut, high-temperature PVC insulated zinc plated steel lever handle, Viton stem ‘O’ ring, PTFE (Teflon) thrust washer and seats and brass bar stem. A gas application guide is as follows; Class 1 is inert including air, argon, carbon dioxide, helium and nitrogen; Class 2 is combustible including hydrogen, methane, natural gas and town gas; Class 3 is corrosive including chlorine and sulphur dioxide; Class 4 is oxygen.

The 1/4 inch to 2 inch body and end piece of the ball valve are made from chrome-plated, forged brass while the 2 1/2 inch to 4 inch body, end piece and ball of the valve are manufactured from chrome-plated, gravity die-cast brass. The 1/4 inch to 1/2 inch ball of the valve is made from a chrome-plated, brass bar while the 3/4 inch to 2 inch ball of the valve is chrome-plated, forged brass.Features & Benefits: Pegler Yorkshire PS550 PN16 DZR Press Ended Lever Ball ValveFull-bore levelXpress ends for copper/carbon steel/stainless steel tubeRange of sizesBrass constructionGas applicationFeaturing a brass (EL) washer, external stem and sleeve, this ball valve also includes a steel (EL) fixing screw, EPDM end connection ‘O’ ring, nickel plated brass security screws, aluminium painted tee handle, zinc plated steel self-locking nut, high-temperature PVC insulated zinc plated steel lever handle, Viton stem ‘O’ ring, PTFE (Teflon) thrust washer and seats and brass bar stem. A gas application guide is as follows; Class 1 is inert including air, argon, carbon dioxide, helium and nitrogen; Class 2 is combustible including hydrogen, methane, natural gas and town gas; Class 3 is corrosive including chlorine and sulphur dioxide; Class 4 is oxygen.
