product.name: Pegler Yorkshire Xpress Copper S8 Press Male Adaptor
product.description: This Xpress copper press male adaptor has so many benefits and ensures major savings in installation costs and time compared with traditional jointing methods as it is part of a completely heat-free jointing system that requires no additional solders, adhesives, compounds, gas, hot works permits or costly insurance. With rapid, clean, heat-free jointing without complicated clamping techniques, long preparation procedures or waiting for adhesive to dry, this Xpress male adaptor is safe without the need for naked flames. With a perfectly clean internal bore, less finishing or cleaning is required and there is no localised annealing from high temperature working. Without carbon deposits, internal solder runs or flux residue, this adaptor decreases the risk of corrosion while the system does not need to be ‘dry’ for effective jointing.Features & Benefits: Pegler Yorkshire Xpress Copper S8 Press Male AdaptorXpress Copper fittingIdeal for diverse applicationsReduced risk of corrosionSaves installation time and costsSelection of sizesRapid, heat-free jointingAssured electrical continuityPerfectly clean internal boreWide range of approvalsSafety with no naked flames This XPress fitting has a wide range of approvals including Kitemark, WRAS and DVGW and electrical continuity is assured when the XPress jointing process is complete. This Xpress male adaptor is ideal for a diverse variety of applications such as domestic maintenance and refurbishment, new build and large-scale public sector projects.

product.name: JTM Compression Copper Olive
product.description: The JTM Compression Copper Olive is a precision-engineered component designed to create secure, leak-free seals in plumbing systems using compression fittings. Crafted from high-quality copper, these olives are essential for joining pipes without the need for heat or soldering, making them ideal for both professional plumbers and DIY enthusiasts.When used within a compression fitting, the olive is compressed between the fitting body and the nut, deforming slightly to form a tight, watertight seal around the pipe. These copper olives are particularly beneficial in situations where soldering is impractical or undesirable, such as in confined spaces or when working with heat-sensitive materials.Features & Benefits: JTM Compression Copper OliveDurable copper, ensuring excellent corrosion resistance and longevitySuitable for use in both hot and cold water systemsMeets British and European standards, ensuring reliability and safety

product.name: John Guest Speedfit Underfloor Heating Manifolds With Push-Fit Connections
product.description: Made of stainless steel, John Guest Speedfit manifolds are quick and easy to install, thanks to the push-fit connections to the heating pipe. To make things even easier, they're pre-fitted with brackets, vibration isolation mounts and an automatic air vent. These manifolds come with protective dust caps on the return rail, which you can remove when installing the product. They also feature circuit actuator valves that open and close the flow of water to each pipe loop. You can assemble them to suit left or right hand supply for greater convenience.And that's not all. These high performance manifolds are approved by the BSI (British Standards Institution), WRAS (Water Regulations Approval Scheme) and several other institutions, so you know they're designed to the highest standards. They're available with anywhere from 2 to 12 ports, making them extremely versatile.Features & Benefits: John Guest Speedfit Underfloor Heating Manifolds With Push-Fit ConnectionsPre-fitted with bracketsIntegral Auto Air Vent discharges any air that might impact circulationValves on the return manifold fully compatible with thermoelectric heads

product.name: John Guest Speedfit x Union Nut with Service Valve (2 Pack)
product.description: This White PVC Flexi Hose is suitable for the connection of plastic or copper pipe onto a male thread appliance such as a tap and has been designed, manufactured and assembled in the UK by John Guest Speedfit. The PVC material significantly reduces the possibilities of the hose ‘kinking’ and ensures an easier clean. One end of this hose features a push-fit connection for a supply pipe and on the other end, there is a brass nut which can be tightened onto a tap or male thread.  If the need arises to demount the connection, push the collet towards the body of the fitting and pull the pipe to release. This flexi hose fitting ensures an easier working environment in confined spaces and removes the need for hot works on site. Installation can be reduced by around 40% against traditional fixing methods. Features & Benefits:  John Guest Speedfit x Union Nut with Service Valve (2 Pack)PVC hose materialWRAS approvedRange of sizes availablePush-fit and demountable connectionsFor the connection of plastic or copper pipe onto a male thread appliance6 Bar at 65°CWhite finishSold in singlesSpeedfit x union nutService valve The strictest control is maintained by virtue of the fact that design and manufacture are carried out in modern purpose-built manufacturing centres in west London and at Maidenhead in Berkshire. Maintaining control over the whole process from initial tool design and tool making through to final assembly and testing ensures that this flexi hose is produced to the highest quality. John Guest Speedfit believe that it is this commitment to quality that has led to it receiving awards from many of the world’s leading testing and approvals organisations. Please note: With all plastic pipes, the relevant manufacturer’s insert is required.This flexi hose is not suitable for central heating systems.

product.name: Geberit Mapress Copper 90 Degree Gas Street Elbow
product.description: This Geberit Mapress Street Elbow is suitable for use with natural gases and/or liquefied gases. The Mapress copper is very easy to press using a pressing tool, ensuring a safe and easy installation with a quick and reliable process without soldering, eliminating the risk of hot works. Available in a range of metric sizes from 15mm up to 54mm. This Geberit copper fitting can be combined with other Gerberit Supply Systems and is made from a Cu-DHP alloy (phosphorus-deoxidised copper). This 90° street elbow has a pressing indicator with a seal ring made of Hydrogenated Rubber (HNBR) and a pressing socket with a yellow protection plug.Features & Benefits: Geberit Mapress Copper 90 Degree Gas Street ElbowAvailable in a range of metric sizes  Made from Cu-DHP alloy  Suitable for use with natural gases and/or liquefied gases  Safe and easy to install without the need for soldering or hot works  Dimension printed on the white pressing indicator  Yellow seal ring made of HNBR  Protection plug prevents fittings from becoming dirty

product.name: Multipanel Linda Barker Calacatta Marble Tongue & Groove Hydrolock Shower Wall Panel
product.description: The Multipanel Linda Barker Calacatta Marble Hydrolock Shower Wall Panel offers a luxurious, fully waterproof solution with a stunning white base and intricate light grey veining, delivering the elegance of natural stone at a fraction of the cost. Part of Multipanel's exclusive Linda Barker collection, this versatile design complements both classic and modern aesthetics.The Hydrolock tongue and groove edge creates a seamless, grout-free finish, simplifying installation. These lightweight 11mm panels can be cut to size and even installed over existing tiles, saving time and effort. Made from FSC-certified Medite Exterior MDF, the panels are 100% recyclable and come with a 30-year warranty. Easy to clean, they require only a damp cloth for maintenance. A stylish, durable, and eco-friendly choice for any modern shower space.Features & Benefits: Multipanel Linda Barker Calacatta Marble Tongue & Groove Hydrolock Shower Wall PanelFeatures Hydrolock tongue and groove edge, which creates an almost seamless surfaceFully waterproof and easy to keep cleanQuick to installPlease note: To maintain Multipanel's 30-year warranty, store panels flat, not vertically or on trestles, and condition at room temperature for 48 hours before installation.Use Multipanel High Grab Panel Adhesive/Sealant. The warranty covers product failure but is void if installation and care guidelines are not followed.For a 100% watertight seal, apply silicone at all edges, whether using profiles, shower enclosures, or the Hydrolock system. Use offcuts behind sinks for a coordinated look, sealing all exposed edges with profiles and silicone.To clean, use warm water and mild detergent. Avoid scouring products, as improper cleaning may invalidate the warranty.

product.name: DEKTITE Diverter EPDM Pipe Flashing for Metal Roofs
product.description: As a highly durable synthetic rubber roofing membrane flashing solution, the large base of this grey EPDM (Ethylene Propylene Diene Terpolymer) flashing for metal roofs dramatically reduces and, as the name suggests, diverts rainwater pooling. This is a common occurrence on both very low and high-pitched roofs as well as deep-ribbed roofing profiles.It gets better. Specifically designed for use on high and low roof pitches, this DEKTITE Diverter is suitable for use on a roof pitch between 0° and 60° and is easy to install. product.description: As a highly durable synthetic rubber roofing membrane flashing solution, the large base of this grey EPDM (Ethylene Propylene Diene Terpolymer) flashing for metal roofs dramatically reduces and, as the name suggests, diverts rainwater pooling. product.name: Belimo 2 Port Valve with a 240v Actuator and Auxiliary Switch - Powered Open/Spring Return
product.description:
This 2 port valve with actuator and auxiliary switch is an excellent powered-open, spring close valve for open and closed cold and warm water systems. Ideal for modulating water-side control of air handling units and heating systems, the system is designed for use in stationary heating, ventilation and air conditioning systems. This valve is also air-bubble tight for reliable action throughout the service life.With a nickel-plated hot-pressed brass valve housing, these valves can be relied on for long-lasting performance throughout the life of your system and can be retrofitted with other actuators in Belimo's extensive range. In addition, in terms of their seal between inlet and outlet, these valves, when closed, have an extremely low leakage rate and are 'air bubble tight' in compliance with EN12266. product.name: Spirotech SpiroTrap Brass Dirt Separator
product.description:
This SpiroTrap MBL dirt separator is a robust and reliable countermeasure against magnetic and non-magnetic dirt particles building up in pipework, slowly damaging the system and lessening efficiency. Available in a range of connection sizes from 1¼", 1½" and 2", these separators provide essential protection without complex and messy maintenance.Easy to install and maintain, these dirt separators do not require any bypasses or shut-off valves to work and can be emptied whilst the system is in operation, taking only a few seconds and eliminating downtime. In addition, these separators can remove extremely fine particles from the system, as small as 5?m/0.005mm.Features & Benefits: Spirotech SpiroTrap Brass Dirt SeparatorRobust protection against magnetic and non-magnetic dirtDoes not require bypasses or shut-off valves to functionEasy and straightforward installation compared to other filter systems
Can be cleared and cleaned with shutting off the systemAvailable in a range of connection sizes from 1¼", 1½" and 2"

product.name: Prorad Double Convector Radiator Type 22 K2 300mm High
product.description: These ProRad radiators feature a decent range of designs: Type 11 (K1), Type 21 (P+) and Type 22 (K2). Slimline single panel designs (Type 11) work great in tight spaces and have smaller footprints. Larger units are bigger in size and have two panels and fins that offer higher heat outputs (BTU).Type 22 radiators include two convectors (rows of fins). By doubling the number of fins, the surface area of the radiator is increased and allows more heat to be produced. This increases the projection of the radiator. Type 22 radiators use both front and back panels to help retain the heat and allow for an improved distribution throughout the room.Features & Benefits: Prorad Double Convector Radiator Type 22 K2 300mm HighTwo convectors (rows of fins)Increased surface area lets more heat be producedProjection of the radiator also increasedFront and back panels to help retain the heatImproved distribution throughout the room

The boiler can be installed either on the wall or into a prefabricated floor-mounted frame, with at least a low-loss header as part of the system.This boiler is very user-friendly, with a simple controls interface with a large backlit display including integrated sequence control. product.name: Climaflex Polyethylene Pipe Insulation 1m Lengths
product.description: Climaflex is a flexible polyethylene foam based closed cell pipe insulation (also known as pipe lagging) suitable for a broad range of water and heating applications, frost protection and impact protection. It can be glued, taped or simply pushed together to form an insulated pipe, making it a convenient, versatile option. Available in 1mtr segments and multiple pipe sizes, Climaflex pipe insulation combines high performance and low cost in most domestic applications, giving you the best of both worlds. While you can also use it externally, keep in mind that it will degrade faster in sunlight.What is more, Climaflex pipe insulation is a sustainable, environmentally friendly solution that is completely CFC (chlorofluorocarbon) and HCFC (hydrochlorofluorocarbon) free and has an ODP (ozone depletion potential) of zero. It can accommodate temperatures ranging from -45 C to +105 C and has excellent thermal conductivity. Features & Benefits: Climaflex Polyethylene Pipe Insulation 1m LengthsHigh performance polyethylene-based closed-cell foam pipe insulation  Suitable for diverse heating and plumbing applications  Available in 1m segments and multiple pipe and thickness sizes  Thermal conductivity of 0.038 W/mK at 40C, 0.036 W/mK at 20C and 0.034 W/mK at 0C  Environmentally friendly  Easy to fit

The high molybdenum content ensures a particularly high corrosion resistance making it a reliable, robust choice.Suitable for use with cooling water with or without antifreeze agent, heating water and hot and cold potable water, this straight coupling can also be used for inert gases (nitrogen), compress air (oil purity 0 to 3), technical liquids, chemicals, sprinklers (wet) and saturated steam at 120°C. product.name: Alumasc Heritage Aluminium Circular Pipe Bend
product.description:
A range of traditionally designed, socketed aluminium downpipes. Connections between pipes and fittings are made with loose cast sockets, available with ears for fixing back to the wall. Pipes can also be fixed with a choice of base clips to give alternative projections.Applications

Ideal for traditionally designed buildings
Heritage downpipes are extruded sections with cast sockets
Compatible with all Alumasc aluminium gutter systems
Factory finished, in a choice of 1, 2 and 3 metre pipe lengths

Colours & Finishes

BBA approved polyester powder coatings
In-house powder coating facility
16 standard factory applied colours
BS or RAL colours available to special order
Can be supplied to resemble cast iron surface texture (black) to special order
Also available in plain mill finish for on-site painting

Performance

UK manufactured, extruded aluminium
Choice of circular, square and rectangular pipes
Lightweight, durable and non-corrodible
Easy to handle and fix
Life expectancy of aluminium: 40 years (rural/suburban areas); up to 25 years (industrial/marine areas)
Aluminium is 100% recyclable

Installation & Fixing

Pipe jointing by separate sockets gives maximum flexibility for installation
Simple fixing to wall by eared sockets or by a choice of pipe clips
Minimal maintenance requirements
product.variant_name: Aluminium Guttering Round Downpipe 92.5dg Bend 63mm - Black

product.name: Potterton Gold Heat Only Electric Boiler
product.description: The Potterton Gold Heat Only Electric Boiler offers a compact and efficient solution for wet central heating systems, ideal for properties where space is limited or gas connections are unavailable. This model provides ample heat for medium-sized homes. Its slimline design allows for discreet installation in cupboards or utility rooms, making it a versatile choice for various domestic settings.Operating on a 230V single-phase supply, the Gold Electric Boiler is suitable for both pressurised and open-vented systems. It features a stainless-steel heat exchanger, ensuring durability and efficient heat transfer. The boiler is compatible with standard radiators and can be controlled using standard programmers, room thermostats, and thermostatic radiator valves. product.name: Alumasc Heritage Aluminium Circular Pipe Shoe with Ears
product.description:
A range of traditionally designed, socketed aluminium downpipes. Connections between pipes and fittings are made with loose cast sockets, available with ears for fixing back to the wall. Pipes can also be fixed with a choice of base clips to give alternative projections.Applications

Ideal for traditionally designed buildings
Heritage downpipes are extruded sections with cast sockets
Compatible with all Alumasc aluminium gutter systems
Factory finished, in a choice of 1, 2 and 3 metre pipe lengths

Colours & Finishes

BBA approved polyester powder coatings
In-house powder coating facility
16 standard factory applied colours
BS or RAL colours available to special order
Can be supplied to resemble cast iron surface texture (black) to special order
Also available in plain mill finish for on-site painting

Performance

UK manufactured, extruded aluminium
Choice of circular, square and rectangular pipes
Lightweight, durable and non-corrodible
Easy to handle and fix
Life expectancy of aluminium: 40 years (rural/suburban areas); up to 25 years (industrial/marine areas)
Aluminium is 100% recyclable

Installation & Fixing

Pipe jointing by separate sockets gives maximum flexibility for installation
Simple fixing to wall by eared sockets or by a choice of pipe clips
Minimal maintenance requirements

product.name: Nabic 1/2 inch 500 High Lift Safety Valve
product.description: This NABIC 500 high lift safety valve is designed primarily for use on unvented hot water heating systems, where a high capacity, emergency steam relief capability is required. Designed and tested to BS EN ISO 4126-1 and WRAS approved, this safety valve has a resilient PTFE seating design with a high degree of seat tightness. This high lift safety valve has a locked and sealed pressure setting. Offering easy inspection and cleaning, this safety valve has a high discharge capacity and diaphragm-protected parts. product.name: Armacell EVO Armaflex Self-Seal Pipe Insulation Full Boxes 2m Lengths - Thickness 25mm
product.description: This box of Armaflex pipe insulation (also known as pipe lagging) is an economical option for purchasing this ever-popular Type O insulation, combining flexibility, reliability, and efficiency to produce a compelling and cost-effective insulation solution. Unlike other insulation types, these Armaflex tubes retain their thermal properties over time, creating an essential moisture barrier to protect against pipe and fitting corrosion. This variant is best suited for temperatures up to 100C and should only be used internally.The closed-cell structure of this material means that even when cut, this insulation retains its vapour-resistant qualities and won't release unwanted dust and fibres if you need to cut and trim on-site. In addition, with the flexibility of these SelfSeal tubes, it's easy to protect vulnerable components, creating truly and fully sealed systems for short-term as well as long-term savings. With a huge range of diameters available, this reliable Type O insulation remains popular for a good reason.Features & Benefits: Armacell EVO Armaflex Self-Seal Pipe Insulation Full Boxes 2m Lengths - Thickness 25mmAllows for fully sealed systems for short and long-term savingsDust free when worked with for easy installationLong term thermal efficiency and energy efficiency

product.description: This box of Armaflex pipe insulation (also known as pipe lagging) is an economical option for purchasing this ever-popular Type O insulation, combining flexibility, reliability, and efficiency to produce a compelling and cost-effective insulation solution. Unlike other insulation types, these Armaflex tubes retain their thermal properties over time, creating an essential moisture barrier to protect against pipe and fitting corrosion. This variant is best suited for temperatures up to 100C and should only be used internally.The closed-cell structure of this material means that even when cut, this insulation retains its vapour-resistant qualities and won't release unwanted dust and fibres if you need to cut and trim on-site. In addition, with the flexibility of these SelfSeal tubes, it's easy to protect vulnerable components, creating truly and fully sealed systems for short-term as well as long-term savings. product.name: Multipanel Linda Barker Salvaged Plank Elm Unlipped Shower Wall Panel
product.description: Bring a touch of rustic style to your bathroom or wet room with the Multipanel Linda Barker Salvaged Planked Elm Unlipped Shower Wall Panel. This fully waterproof panel showcases a charming assortment of grey, beige and brown tones, featuring an authentic woodgrain-effect pattern, including wood knots. The Salvaged Planked Elm pattern is designed to replicate the rugged allure of genuine reclaimed, weathered Elm timber planks, bringing a warm, earthy aesthetic to your bathroom or wet room.Hand-selected as part of Multipanel's exclusive Linda Barker collection, these beautiful, modern designs have been curated by the renowned interior designer, who has taken inspiration from various natural elements and materials, such as wood, metal and stone. The panel has an unlipped bare edge, which provides flexibility in fitting options, and it is a decorative alternative to wall tiles that won't require grout.Features & Benefits: Multipanel Linda Barker Salvaged Plank Elm Unlipped Shower Wall Panel11mm thick with an unlipped bare edge for versatile fitting optionsCan be installed over existing tiles for time and cost savings100% recyclable, made from FSC-certified materials and has a 30-year warrantyPlease note: To maintain Multipanel's 30-year warranty, store panels flat, not vertically or on trestles, and condition at room temperature for 48 hours before installation.Use Multipanel High Grab Panel Adhesive/Sealant. The warranty covers product failure but is void if installation and care guidelines are not followed.For a 100% watertight seal, apply silicone at all edges, whether using profiles, shower enclosures, or the Hydrolock system. Use offcuts behind sinks for a coordinated look, sealing all exposed edges with profiles and silicone.To clean, use warm water and mild detergent. Avoid scouring products, as improper cleaning may invalidate the warranty.

product.name: Zilmet CAL-PRO Floor Standing Heating Expansion Vessel
product.description: CAL-PRO expansion vessels by Zilmet absorb the water volume variations in closed heating systems. They maintain constant pressure, which helps reduce energy consumption and saves you money. They’re available in a broad range of capacity from 4 litres to 900 litres, making them an ideal solution for various domestic and commercial unvented central heating systems. CAL-PRO vessels work by accommodating the increased water volume during system heating in an unvented circuit. Thanks to the pressurised membrane, water can enter or leave only during periods of heating and cooling.The sturdy vessels consist of crimped or welded carbon steel shells and synthetic SBR (styrene-butadiene) rubber according to DIN 4807-3 norms (‘Expansion Vessels, Elastomer Membranes; Requirements and Testing’), which maximise tank drawdown for all capacities. They’re painted on the outside with red epoxy polyester powder coating which provides an elegant, long-lasting finish. CAL-PRO vessels can operate between -10°C and 90°C and have a maximum working pressure between 1.5 bar and 6 bar depending on their capacity.Features & Benefits: Zilmet CAL-PRO Floor Standing Heating Expansion VesselLong-lasting energy: efficient heating expansion vessels  Available in multiple capacities of  4l to 900 l  Made of carbon steel and SBR rubber  Available in red  Maximum operating temperature -10°C to 90°C Please note: Please note CAL-PRO vessels between 4 litres and 24 litres are sold complete with bracket.

product.name: Pegler Yorkshire Xpress Copper Gas SG61 Press Stop End
product.description: This Xpress Copper Gas Press stop end ensures that safety is paramount by offering swift, flame-free installation alongside assuring consistent high-quality and performance for your commercial gas system. It has a wide range of British and International approvals including BSI Kitemark approval (BS 8537:2010).  This Xpress stop end has a temperature rating from -20°C to 70°C and a maximum working pressure of 1 bar inside and 5 bar outside. product.name: John Guest Speedfit 5 Layer PEX Barrier Pipe Coil
product.description: Speedfit PEX (Cross-Linked Polyethylene, an alternative to plastic and copper for home plumbing) barrier pipes are lightweight and flexible, making them perfect for underfloor heating installations. Thanks to their low thermal conductivity, these pipes are cooler and safer to touch when carrying hot water. They feature an inner barrier which prevents the flow of air. Produced and kitemarked to BS7291: Parts 1, 2 and 3: Class S standard, Speedfit PEX pipes are accredited by the BSI (British Standards Institution), WRAS (Water Regulations Approval Scheme) and several other organisations. They're available in diameter sizes of 10mm to 22mm and multiple lengths to suit the specific requirements of your project. To function in a screed system, the pipes are attached directly to insulation with staples, floor clips or mounting rails.Features & Benefits: John Guest Speedfit 5 Layer PEX Barrier Pipe CoilFlexible, lightweight PEX pipesSuitable for central heating systemsLead-free and non-toxicPlease note: John Guest Speedfit pipe inserts must be used with these pipes.

Thanks to their low thermal conductivity, these pipes are cooler and safer to touch when carrying hot water. They feature an inner barrier which prevents the flow of air. Produced and kitemarked to BS7291: Parts 1, 2 and 3: Class S standard, Speedfit PEX pipes are accredited by the BSI (British Standards Institution), WRAS (Water Regulations Approval Scheme) and several other organisations. They're available in diameter sizes of 10mm to 22mm and multiple lengths to suit the specific requirements of your project. To function in a screed system, the pipes are attached directly to insulation with staples, floor clips or mounting rails.Features & Benefits: John Guest Speedfit 5 Layer PEX Barrier Pipe CoilFlexible, lightweight PEX pipesSuitable for central heating systemsLead-free and non-toxicPlease note: John Guest Speedfit pipe inserts must be used with these pipes.

product.name: Reliance Water Controls 320 Series Easiset 45 Degree Pressure Reducing Valve
product.description: The 320 Series of pressure reducing valves by RWC are ideal for protecting water supply installations against excess supply pressures and fluctuating mains supplies that might otherwise damage your plumbing system. They feature an easy-to-read unique indicator that can identify set pressure without a pressure gauge. These robust valves are suitable for use in both hot and cold supplies with pressure up to 25 bar and maximum temperature of 70°C. What’s more, they’re adjustable between 1-6 bar and can be installed in any orientation, making them a convenient solution. Thanks to the drop tight valve, pressure under flow and no flow conditions is controlled securely.These sturdy valves are made from DZR (dezincification resistant) brass for high durability, designed to a strict BSEN 1567 Water Pressure Reducing Valves and Combination Water Reducing Valves standard and approved by the WRAS (Water Regulations Approval Scheme), so you can be sure they’re of the highest quality.Features & Benefits: Reliance Water Controls 320 Series Easiset 45 Degree Pressure Reducing Valve Robust DRZ pressure reducing valvesEasy-to-read pressure indicatorCan be installed in any orientationSingle-piece, easy to replace cartridgeFully serviceable integral strainerSuitable for cold suppliesDesigned to BSEN 1567 & WRAS approved

product.name: DeWalt Newark Brown Waterproof Safety Boot
product.description: The high-quality full-grain black leather Newark Black Waterproof Safety Boot from DeWalt is an excellent solution for those jobs that require you to be outside working in all weathers. As well as water resistance, the boot provides exceptional comfort, protection and grip.Featuring a waterproof and breathable Samsung membrane lining, your feet will be kept dry when working in sudden rain showers or general damp conditions. The heel support system and cleated dual-density outsole, made from flexible and abrasion-resistant Thermoplastic Polyurethane (TPU), ensure excellent support and grip.Features & Benefits: DeWalt Newark Brown Waterproof Safety BootA high-quality, water-resistant full-grain black leather safety bootS3 safety ratingProvides exceptional comfort, protection and gripWaterproof and breathable Samsung membrane liningTPU heel support system and cleated dual-density outsole200-joule steel top cap and anti-scuff toe guardSteel midsole to protect against objects puncturing the solePU comfort insole and a thick padded tongue and collarAvailable in various sizesThe safety boot has a 200-joule steel top cap to protect your toes from heavy loads and an anti-scuff toe guard. While safety is always at the forefront, comfort when working is equally important. DeWalt has designed the Newark Black Safety Boot with a PU comfort insole for the soles of your feet and a thick padded tongue and collar that will cushion your ankles.Standards & CertificationEuropean Standard: EN 20345: 2011 S3Slip Resistance: SRCPlease note: This footwear has been tested on clay tiles with a sodium lauryl sulphate solution and meets a minimum Coefficient of Friction (CoF) of 0.32 tested flat and a CoF of 0.28 when tested at the heel.This footwear is also tested on stainless steel with a glycerol solution and meets a CoF of 0.18 when tested flat and 0.13 at the heel.

product.description: From ProRad, these Type 22 (K2) radiators come in a variety of widths to accommodate rooms of different dimensions, making them an excellent choice for heating almost any space. product.name: Multipanel Classic White Snow Tongue & Groove Hydrolock Shower Wall Panel
product.description: The stunning Multipanel Classic White Snow Hydrolock Shower Wall Panel brings timeless elegance and spa-like luxury to any bathroom or wet room. Featuring a white base with sparkling flecks, it captures and reflects light, creating a bright, sophisticated ambiance that complements both traditional and modern aesthetics.The Hydrolock tongue and groove edge allows for seamless, mid-joint-free installation, ensuring a smooth, flawless finish. These fully waterproof, 11mm thick panels are quick to install, can be cut to size, and even fitted over existing tiles, saving time and effort. Backed by a 30-year warranty for lasting peace of mind.Features & Benefits: Multipanel Classic White Snow Tongue & Groove Hydrolock Shower Wall PanelWhite base with light-reflecting flecks for a sparkling effectHydrolock technology for a seamlessFSC-certified, 100% recyclable Medite MDFPlease note: To maintain Multipanel's 30-year warranty, store panels flat, not vertically or on trestles, and condition at room temperature for 48 hours before installation.Use Multipanel High Grab Panel Adhesive/Sealant. The warranty covers product failure but is void if installation and care guidelines are not followed.For a 100% watertight seal, apply silicone at all edges, whether using profiles, shower enclosures, or the Hydrolock system. Use offcuts behind sinks for a coordinated look, sealing all exposed edges with profiles and silicone.To clean, use warm water and mild detergent. Avoid scouring products, as improper cleaning may invalidate the warranty.

product.name: Vaillant EcoFit Sustain Combi Natural Gas Boiler
product.description: The 100% recyclable EcoFit Sustain Combi Natural Gas Boiler from Vaillant is a shining example of efficiency, compactness and sustainability in home heating. With various power outputs, including 25kW, 30kW, and 35kW, there's an ecoFIT Pure model perfectly tailored to meet the heating demands of any household. This boiler is a performance powerhouse, boasting an ErP A rating with up to 94% efficiency. This easily makes it the top choice for individuals seeking to reduce their carbon footprint and cut down on fuel expenses.The ecoFit Pure Combi is built for longevity, featuring a top-tier aluminium heat exchanger designed for extended service life and easy maintenance, ensuring a seamless operation. Its compact and lightweight design makes sure it can seamlessly fit within a conventional kitchen cupboard, preserving valuable space while delivering exceptional heating capabilities. What truly distinguishes this system is its cutting-edge reduced-noise design, proudly recognized with the Quiet Mark by the Noise Abatement Society. With the option to install a rear flue, this boiler emerges as the ultimate solution for kitchen cupboard installations, offering both efficiency and convenience.Features & Benefits: Vaillant EcoFit Sustain Combi Natural Gas Boiler100% recyclable boiler with rear flue optionAluminium heat exchanger for longevityHighly energy-efficientMultiple outputs availableCompatible with Vaillant’s vSMART™ app based control for remote controlErP A ratedIdeal kitchen cupboard fir solutionQuiet performanceHelps prevent frost damage

product.name: Nabic 1 1/2 inch 500 High Lift Safety Valve
product.description: This NABIC 500 high lift safety valve has been designed primarily for use on unvented hot water heating systems where a high capacity, emergency steam relief capability is required. All wetted parts are manufactured from dezincification resistance materials. Designed and tested to BS EN ISO 4126-1 and WRAS approved (1 bar and above), this safety valve is available in a wide range of sizes and has a resilient PTFE seating design with a high degree of seat tightness. Ensuring easy inspection and cleaning, it has diaphragm-protected parts and a locked and sealed pressure seating. product.name: Aqualisa eVolve Black Electric Shower With Adjustable Head
product.description: In stunning Midnight Black, with a contoured, satin silver trim, the streamlined eVolve electric shower has unmistakeable style appeal and all-round quality. Design detail and superb installation flexibility make it the perfect solution for showering on-demand. Retrofitable for most electric shower units, the multi-fit connection options make upgrades and replacements problem free. Alternative power settings and three spray patterns give plenty of showering choices in terms of force and coverage. A separate temperature control smoothly adjusts to the required level, which is digitally displayed and kept safe by the over temperature stop function. Automatic phased shutdown reduces limescale build-up for better performance and product durability.

product.name: Multipanel Contemporary Arctic Stone Unlipped Shower Wall Panel
product.description: A versatile gem within Multipanel's Contemporary collection, the Multipanel Contemporary Arctic Stone Unlipped Shower Wall Panel effortlessly marries affordability with the luxurious look of solid real stone. Its Arctic Stone finish is a highly textured design showcasing an authentic grey stone effect with a subtle blend of grey and white tones. Take your bathroom or wet room to the next level by introducing a touch of modern Zen-inspired aesthetics.Thanks to being fully waterproof, this 11mm thick panel is designed to withstand the rigours of wet and humid environments. Not only can it be installed without the need for grout and also installed directly over existing wall tiles. Its unlipped bare edge offers excellent flexibility in fitting options, allowing for a customised installation tailored to your design preferences.Features & Benefits: Multipanel Contemporary Arctic Stone Unlipped Shower Wall PanelA highly textured design showcasing an authentic grey stone effect patternQuick and simple to install and can be cut to size100% recyclable, made from FSC-certified materials, and comes with a 30-year warrantyPlease note: To maintain Multipanel's 30-year warranty, store panels flat, not vertically or on trestles, and condition at room temperature for 48 hours before installation.Use Multipanel High Grab Panel Adhesive/Sealant. The warranty covers product failure but is void if installation and care guidelines are not followed.For a 100% watertight seal, apply silicone at all edges, whether using profiles, shower enclosures, or the Hydrolock system. Use offcuts behind sinks for a coordinated look, sealing all exposed edges with profiles and silicone.To clean, use warm water and non-abrasive mild detergent. Avoid scouring products, as improper cleaning may invalidate the warranty.

product.name: MAGNA1 D 180 A RatedEuP Ready Variable Speed Twin Head Circulator 240V
product.description:
This Grundfos MAGNA1 32 series (180) 'A' Rated/EuP Ready variable speed twin head circulator with an easy selection of pump settings has no maintenance requirements and an extremely low life cycle cost. This MAGNA1 circulator pump is designed for circulating liquids in heating systems with variable flows and for domestic hot-water systems.Applications include heating systems, air-conditioning and heating, main pump and mixing loops. This pump is also suitable for systems with hot-water priority as an external signal can immediately force the pump to operate according to the max. curve, for example in solar heating systems.Features & Benefits: MAGNA1 D 180 A RatedEuP Ready Variable Speed Twin Head Circulator 240VThree proportional-pressure curves, three constant-pressure curves and three fixed-speed curves availableNine light fields for indication of pump settingsComplies with EuP requirementsMaintenance-free and long lifeLow energy consumptionLow noise levelSimple installationSafe selection Liquid temperature range from -10°C to 110°CWater pumped liquidThis MAGNA1 32 series 240V circulator has 180mm port-to-port dimensions and 2” BSPM screwed connections. product.name: Alumasc Heritage Aluminium Circular Access Pipe
product.description:
A range of traditionally designed, socketed aluminium downpipes. Connections between pipes and fittings are made with loose cast sockets, available with ears for fixing back to the wall. Pipes can also be fixed with a choice of base clips to give alternative projections.Applications

Ideal for traditionally designed buildings
Heritage downpipes are extruded sections with cast sockets
Compatible with all Alumasc aluminium gutter systems
Factory finished, in a choice of 1, 2 and 3 metre pipe lengths

Colours & Finishes

BBA approved polyester powder coatings
In-house powder coating facility
16 standard factory applied colours
BS or RAL colours available to special order
Can be supplied to resemble cast iron surface texture (black) to special order
Also available in plain mill finish for on-site painting

Performance

UK manufactured, extruded aluminium
Choice of circular, square and rectangular pipes
Lightweight, durable and non-corrodible
Easy to handle and fix
Life expectancy of aluminium: 40 years (rural/suburban areas); up to 25 years (industrial/marine areas)
Aluminium is 100% recyclable

Installation & Fixing

Pipe jointing by separate sockets gives maximum flexibility for installation
Simple fixing to wall by eared sockets or by a choice of pipe clips
Minimal maintenance requirements
product.variant_name: Aluminium Guttering Round Downpipe Access Pipe 63mm - Black

A range of traditionally designed, socketed aluminium downpipes. Connections between pipes and fittings are made with loose cast sockets, available with ears for fixing back to the wall. Pipes can also be fixed with a choice of base clips to give alternative projections.Applications

Ideal for traditionally designed buildings
Heritage downpipes are extruded sections with cast sockets
Compatible with all Alumasc aluminium gutter systems
Factory finished, in a choice of 1, 2 and 3 metre pipe lengths

Colours & Finishes

BBA approved polyester powder coatings
In-house powder coating facility
16 standard factory applied colours
BS or RAL colours available to special order
Can be supplied to resemble cast iron surface texture (black) to special order
Also available in plain mill finish for on-site painting

Performance

UK manufactured, extruded aluminium
Choice of circular, square and rectangular pipes
Lightweight, durable and non-corrodible
Easy to handle and fix
Life expectancy of aluminium: 40 years (rural/suburban areas); up to 25 years (industrial/marine areas)
Aluminium is 100% recyclable

Installation & Fixing

Pipe jointing by separate sockets gives maximum flexibility for installation
Simple fixing to wall by eared sockets or by a choice of pipe clips
Minimal maintenance requirements

product.name: Ideal Evomax 2 Commercial Condensing LPG Wall Hung Boiler
product.description: The Ideal Commercial Boilers' Evomax 2 Commercial Condensing Wall Hung LPG Boiler is a cutting-edge heating solution engineered for outstanding performance and efficiency. Utilising liquid petroleum gas from a storage tank, rather than relying on the gas mains, these boilers come equipped with upgraded controls, including a newly introduced cascade control option and a built-in non-return valve, ensuring precise and dependable operation. The Evomax 2 also boasts improved accessibility for simplified maintenance, featuring a reduced lifting weight of up to 10%. Its robust cast aluminium silicon alloy heat exchanger guarantees remarkable efficiency rates of up to 99.6% at full load, making it an eco-friendly choice for commercial heating requirements, even with temperature differentials of up to 30 Degrees.To complement the Evomax 2, Ideal Commercial Boilers offers new Brazed Plate Heat Exchangers designed for multiple boiler cascades. By utilizing Evomax 2 cascades, you can now achieve impressive outputs of up to 900kW. This ensures that the heating system can meet a wide range of installation needs while maintaining peak performance and energy efficiency.Features & Benefits: Ideal Evomax 2 Commercial Condensing LPG Wall Hung BoilerHigh-performance LPG wall hung boilerUp to 10% reduced lift weightIncludes an innovative cascade control optionFeatures a built-in, serviceable non-return valve30-120kW outputs availableHigh 5:1 turndownCapable of operating at up to 30 Degrees Delta TUp to 99.6% full load efficiency & up to 110% part load efficiencyNOxLess than 40mg/kWh (Class 6)Cascade control options for flexible, increased output
product.variant_name: Ideal Evomax 2 Commercial Condensing Wall Hung Boiler LPG Version 30kw

product.name: 2 Multiline Cascade Kits
product.description: These Multiline Cascade Kits from Ideal Commercial Boilers are designed to streamline the installation process for up to six Evomax 2 boilers in a cascade configuration, with a combined capacity of up to 600kW. These kits are available in both starter and extension packs, providing a convenient solution for connecting Evomax 2 boilers that are installed as part of an open flue system through a common flue header. This simplifies the overall system design and installation process by establishing a single point of connection for the flue.In order to ensure the safe operation of the system, non-return valves are integrated to prevent the backflow of combustion byproducts through any individual boiler that is not currently firing. Additionally, any condensate generated within the flue is efficiently channelled through the central trough of the header duct and exits the system via a siphon, further contributing to the system's reliability and safety.Features & Benefits: 2 Multiline Cascade KitsHigh-capacity cascade kits for Evomax 2 boilersCan cascade up to 6 boilers600kW system capacityCome with everything necessary for hassle-free installationIntegrated non-return valves for improved safetyAvailable as starter & extension kits

product.name: Altecnic Reflex Mini Expansion Vessels for Potable Water
product.description: This Reflex horizontal expansion vessel is for potable water. Closed hot water circuits cannot compress water, so any rise in volume from temperature changes needs to be accommodated by an expansion vessel. When water is cold, the pre-charge pressure makes the bladder collapse until the pump starts up as the bladder inflates. The system temperature increases due to the associated increase in pressure and volume, in turn allowing expanded water to enter the bladder adding volume and lowering pressure. With the decrease in temperature decreases, the pre-charge pressure pushes water back to the main water circuit.Features & Benefits: Altecnic Reflex Mini Expansion Vessels for Potable WaterFor potable waterAccommodates volume changeSize options available

product.name: John Guest Speedfit White Flexi Hose
product.description: This White PVC Flexi Hose is suitable for the connection of plastic or copper pipe and has been designed, manufactured and assembled in the UK by John Guest Speedfit. The PVC material significantly reduces the possibilities of the hose ‘kinking’ and ensures an easier clean. Both ends feature a Speedfit fitting connection of a 15mm pipe to a 15mm pipe.  If the need arises to demount the connection, push the collet towards the body of the fitting and pull the pipe to release. This flexi hose fitting ensures an easier working environment in confined spaces and removes the need for hot works on site. Installation can be reduced by around 40% against traditional fixing methods. Features & Benefits: John Guest Speedfit White Flexi HoseWRAS approvedRange of sizes availableFor the connection of plastic or copper pipeWhite finishSpeedfit x SpeedfitSold in singles6 Bar at 65°CPush-fit and demountable connectionsPVC hose material The strictest control is maintained by virtue of the fact that design and manufacture are carried out in modern purpose-built manufacturing centres in west London and at Maidenhead in Berkshire. Maintaining control over the whole process from initial tool design and tool making through to final assembly and testing ensures that this flexi hose is produced to the highest quality. John Guest Speedfit believe that it is this commitment to quality that has led to it receiving awards from many of the world’s leading testing and approvals organisations. Please note: With all plastic pipes, the relevant manufacturer’s insert is required.This flexi hose is not suitable for central heating systems.

product.description: Designed to transform rooms with a bold and authentic natural slate-like aesthetic, the Multipanel Classic Riven Slate Tongue & Groove Hydrolock Shower Wall Panel adds a high-end charm to your bathroom or wet room. product.name: Altecnic Antifreeze Brass Valve
product.description: Eliminate the risk of expensive equipment damage caused by ice formation in your heat pump system with the Altecnic Antifreeze Brass Valve. This reliable accessory, which will allow the circuit medium to be drained when temperatures reach an average of 3?C, will attach to fittings and M BSP pipes connected by a union, ensuring a long-lasting and durable solution.This affordable option is environmentally friendly and eliminates the need for antifreeze.
